Entries.Title: FAIRY TAIL 100 YEARS QUEST
Entries.Description: The rowdiest guild in Fiore Kingdom is back! Natsu, Lucy, Gray, Erza, and the whole Fairy Tail guild tackle the legendary "100 Years Quest," tougher than any S-Class quest. Their goal: find the first wizard guild ever, located in the far north of Guiltina. Facing new gods, mysterious towns, and ominous foes, they’ll have their work cut out for them. Will they succeed where no wizard has before?

Episodes.Title: The "First" Guild and the "Strongest" Guild
Episodes.Description: Natsu and friends visit the very first Wizard Guild to take a quest that no one has ever completed: the "100 Years Quest." Meanwhile, new recruits join Fairy Tail, but one of them is a little odder than usual...

Episodes.Title: The Sea of Dragons
Episodes.Description: The town of Ermina turns out to be a city for fish, where the whole town is submerged in water during high tide. The moment the party mentions Water God Dragon, the fish turn hostile.

Episodes.Title: Blade, Armor, Ash
Episodes.Description: Dragon Eaters are after Mercphobia to gain the power of Water God Dragon. Natsu and the others join in the battle to aid him, but the foes are strong. Meanwhile, Gajeel, Juvia, and Lily investigate Touka despite the protest from Levy.

Episodes.Title: Dyed White
Episodes.Description: Natsu, Wendy, and Erza are captured by the Diabolos, and Lucy sets out to go rescue them. On her way, she meets someone unexpected… Meanwhile, Jellal finds out the secret of Touka.

Episodes.Title: A Bitter Choice
Episodes.Description: Natsu and the others manage to drive away the Diabolos for now. Then Mercphobia starts to destroy Ermina and its people, which forces Natsu and his friends to make a tough decision. Meanwhile, the White Mage sets out to do what she came to do…

Episodes.Title: Lineage of Fire
Episodes.Description: When Mercphobia goes out of control and almost takes out Natsu, a hand shows up to save him. And it belongs to someone Natsu didn't expect: The Fire Dragon God and the son of Igneel, Ignia.

Episodes.Title: All's Well That Ends Well
Episodes.Description: As a thank-you for saving Ermina, Mercphobia gives the group information on the rest of the Five Dragon Gods. And while they're in the town of Tekka, they encounter someone who looks exactly like Erza...

Episodes.Title: Aldoron, the Wood Dragon God
Episodes.Description: The group is headed to Drasil to find Aldoron. Juvia joins, but she is acting strange and warns the group about the White Mage. Drasil turns out to be a town built on Aldoron, and a kind old man shows them around town. But then...

Episodes.Title: Whiteout
Episodes.Description: Touka the White Mage brainwashed the Fairy Tail members. She plans to destroy the orbs of the five towns on Aldoron to defeat him; Natsu and the other must fight their friends to save them from the White Mage and stop her plan.

Episodes.Title: New Foes
Episodes.Description: Natsu, Lucy, Gray, and Erza fight their own Guild friends to free them from the hypnosis. Then, Wendy encounters a new Dragon Eater. And another Dragon Eater Natsu meets turns out to be...

Episodes.Title: Wraith, the Spirit Dragon
Episodes.Description: Natsu fights Wraith, the Spirit Dragon, but Natsu's attacks are useless against him. On the verge of death, Natsu sees Zeref, Mavis, and Igneel. As a thoughtform, Natsu is finally able to attack Wraith. That's when Wraith finds a body to possess...

Episodes.Title: A Card in the Hand
Episodes.Description: It turns out that Wraith used to be a Fairy Tail wizard, and Makarov and Wraith were a guild family. Meanwhile, Wendy struggles against Nebaru, and Lucy starts collecting the other Fairy Tail members with the help of Cana and her Magic Cards.

Episodes.Title: Scarlet Showdown
Episodes.Description: Natsu and Happy find out that Touka is actually a cat, and she has mistaken Happy as Natsu. Meanwhile, Laxus unleashes his new skill, Red Lightning, against Erza. Now it's down to two orbs, but when Happy throws an orb at the White Mage...

Episodes.Title: Clinging Dragon Berserk
Episodes.Description: The outcomes of the battles are being decided... While Lucy and the others continue trying to enclose their comrades within the cards, Wendy faces off against the sticky dragon Nebaru, who wants to devour her!

Episodes.Title: The Howling Earth
Episodes.Description: When all five orbs are broken, something unexpected happens: The Wood Dragon God, Aldoron, is revived. It also activates God Seeds, who start attacking Natsu and the others by becoming the person who they consider to be the strongest.

Episodes.Title: God Seeds
Episodes.Description: Natsu turns Wolfen into a fake Zeref and uses Ankhseram's curse on Wolfen. Other Fairy Tail wizards face three other God Seeds: Metro, Gears, and Doom. Then, the leader of God Seeds, Aldoron, shows up in front of Natsu

Episodes.Title: Strength to Live
Episodes.Description: Gray and Juvia take on Metro's main body, while the others fight his golems. In the meantime, Jellal takes on Gears. When it's down to Aldoron himself, an unexpected yet familiar face shows up: Brandish.

Episodes.Title: Burning Will
Episodes.Description: Gajeel turns into a giant by Brandish's magic and fights the Wood Dragon God. Now all that's left to defeat is the God Seed Aldoron. Natsu's fire burns Aldoron, who has no respect for human lives as he regards them only as his food.

Episodes.Title: Aqua Aera
Episodes.Description: White Mage uses Aqua Aera, Touka's spell, to take Fairy Tail wizards to Elentear, her homeland, but they end up in Edolas. After they get reunited with the Fairy Tail in Edolas, Natsu and the others go to see Mystogan for help.

Episodes.Title: Selene, the Moon Dragon God
Episodes.Description: The White Mage reveals that her name is Faris and she is from Elentear. She tells the Fairy Tail that she was only doing the Moon Dragon God Selene's bidding to save Elentear. When Selene shows up, she send everyone to Elentear.

Episodes.Title: The Moonlight Divinities
Episodes.Description: After Selene transports Natsu and the others to Elentear, they are attacked by her lackeys, the Moonlight Divinities. They fight with the Spirit Arts, which is different from Magic or spells, and the Fairy Tail wizards are in trouble.

Episodes.Title: The Demons' Parade
Episodes.Description: With Aquarius' help, those who have turned into yokai get back to normal. Lucy’s Celestial Spirits all come out to help, and they defeat Yoko. Meanwhile, Touka and Faris meet Suzaku at Whiteout Village.

Episodes.Title: Sword Saint
Episodes.Description: After Natsu and the others took down Yoko, they meet Suzaku, a Dragon Slayer of Diabolos, who has been summoned from Earthland to defeat Selene. Also known as Sword Saint, Suzaku is a formidable foe and Fairy Tail is helpless against him.

Episodes.Title: This Hideous World
Episodes.Description: Gray fights Hakune once again, and his love for Juvia breaks Hakune's attack. Selene reveals to Suzaku that the dragon he ate is her son. Then Wendy finds a connection between tha Hands and the Face of Tartarus.

Episodes.Title: Homecoming
Episodes.Description: Natsu and the others defeat Alta Face and save Elentear. They're reunited with the guild members in Drasil, but their 100 Years Quest continues. Meanwhile, Selene is taken to Diabolos after being defeated by Suzaku. But things are not what it seems...

Entries.Title: Saving Grace
Entries.Description: Anna, an elementary school teacher, discovers that her student Grace is a victim of abuse. Driven by maternal instinct, Anna abducts Grace to protect her and assumes the role of a mother. As they bond amid threats from the authorities and Grace's abusive mother, Anna confronts her painful past, realizing that she needs healing as much as Grace does.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Anna, an emotionally distant teacher, determinedly prepares for an opportunity abroad. However, an unexpected turn of events leads her to meet Grace, a young student suffering from abuse. As she grows closer to the young girl, Anna becomes torn between pursuing her dreams and saving Grace from her abusive parents.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Anna rescues Grace and accompanies her to Quezon, but they face numerous setbacks along the way. The news of Grace's disappearance reaches public affairs host Miranda Valdez, who then shows interest in the story to save her program. Meanwhile, Chito gets questioned by the authorities about the possible abuse of the missing child.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Anna and Grace find refuge in Lucia's abandoned orphanage. While Anna works to provide for their needs, her past catches up with her when Miranda, Detective Oscar and TV producer Julius investigate her involvement in the missing girl's case. As the pressure of investigation mounts and Lucia's vindictive son looms eviction, Anna faces a heart-wrenching decision for Grace.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Tension rises when the police locate Lucia's orphanage and Sarah catches sight of her daughter, Grace. Luckily, Grace manages to escape while Sarah is left bewildered by her action. Left with no other option, Anna takes Grace to Palawan and seeks help from her adoptive mother, Helena. However, family tensions rise, threatening to expose Anna's secret.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: To protect Grace, Anna is forced to pretend that the former is her child and divert the police investigation away from her. However, Julius relentlessly asks questions who the child's father is, while Helena starts to doubt her supposed granddaughter's identity. Soon, a heated confrontation compels Anna to reveal her long-buried secrets.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: After discovering that Anna is hiding Grace, Julius forces them to surrender. However, an accident strands them in a deserted house where Anna and Grace reveal to Julius the whole truth behind their actions. Tensions escalate at the Sarmientos' inn as Miranda, Oscar, Sarah, and Chito become more suspicious of Anna compelling her to choose between Grace and her family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Helena urges Anna to return Grace to her mother, while Sarah's persistent harassment causes an accident at the Sarmiento's inn. Julius helps Anna and Grace hide, but Jessica soon finds their shelter and gets incriminating evidence against Anna. Meanwhile, a stolen bracelet leads Miranda to uncover a shocking truth about someone she has been searching for over the years.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: After discovering Anna's past, an unjust manipulation of their interview compels Miranda to choose between helping Anna and protecting her career. A heated confrontation between Miranda and Helena causes past pains to resurface. Grace's and Anna's safety are put at risk when Princess makes a reckless decision and Julius' father discovers his involvement in the missing girl's case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Despite managing to escape Palawan with her help, Anna struggles to fully trust Miranda. Meanwhile, Miranda receives a startling news that makes her determined to set things right for Anna. While the television host works to clear Anna's name and exposes Sarah's true nature, Sarah finds someone's help to fight back Miranda, raising suspicions about who might be hiding Anna.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Helena is desperate to keep Anna away from Miranda, fearing that their growing bond will unravel her dark secrets. Anna, determined to flee with Grace, considers questionable means when their hideout gets discovered. Jessica's actions become more unpredictable, while Sarah's growing suspicions intensify the looming threat.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: As Oscar closes in on Grace and Anna, Erin's resurfacing memories reveal the root of Anna's painful past. Princess' betrayal prompts the Sarmientos to uncover a life-altering truth about Helena. In a selfless move, Miranda makes a sacrifice that will put her career and reputation in jeopardy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Anna's world crumbles when she discovers a long-buried family secret. Miranda entrusts Grace with the key to her shared past with Anna and tries to protect her secret at all costs. However, a revenge-driven Sarah exposes a startling revelation that threatens to break Anna and Miranda's fragile bond.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Despite Miranda's struggle with her worsening condition, Anna finds it difficult to forgive her biological mother. However, a sudden discovery leads to Anna's change of heart. As everyone continues to search for Grace, the accused teacher faces harassment and serious charges in court—until an unexpected arrival seemingly changes everything.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Grace does everything she can to help Anna, only to hear that she has to stay in a shelter for her safety and well-being. Meanwhile, Sarah's anger fuels her relentless drive to win Grace back, leading her to make a desperate attempt to reclaim her daughter. As tensions escalate, Anna makes a bold and unexpected move to save Grace.

Episodes.Title: Run!

Episodes.Title: Payment
Episodes.Description: After receiving payment for their services, Andres, Tomas, Max, and JB will face their personal problems as they go back to their respective lives.

Episodes.Title: Lights Out
Episodes.Description: The team faces a major setback due to Donato's actions. As a result, the Contractor gives the team a new mission that they cannot refuse.

Episodes.Title: Territory
Episodes.Description: Timor appoints Clover to lead the organization in his absense. With Greg's promise, JB and the team reflects on the reasons of their dismissal.

Episodes.Title: Trouble
Episodes.Description: Having new identities, the team flies to Cerdova for their new mission. Despite Greg's orders to avoid getting attention, trouble seems to find them.

Episodes.Title: Pursuit
Episodes.Description: Andres sets out on a personal mission, increasing JB's suspicion. JB and Max decide to keep an eye on Andres, but this leads them to someone else.

Episodes.Title: Face to Face
Episodes.Description: Trying to get an intel on their target, Tomas runs into someone suspicious. Andres puts on an act to gain the trust of Timor's associate.

Episodes.Title: Ambush
Episodes.Description: Finding an opportunity, KB and Andres immediately takes into action that goes against Greg's plan. This leads the team to dangerous consequences.

Episodes.Title: Cerdova
Episodes.Description: After retrieving Miguel and Tomas, Greg swoops in to rescue Max, JB and Andres from the crossfire. Together, they must make a daring escape from Cerdova.

Episodes.Title: Motive
Episodes.Description: The team stays at the hideout while awaiting further orders, but Andres' emotions take over when he's face to face with the gang leader.

Episodes.Title: Bargain
Episodes.Description: After an outburst that injures their target, Greg talks to Andres about his temper. Timor uses the situation to his advantage.

Episodes.Title: Assault
Episodes.Description: Timor tries to find an ally within the Contractor's team, prompting JB, Andres and Max to reconcile. Masked figures attack the hideout.

Episodes.Title: Headshot
Episodes.Description: The team must protect their valuable asset as their hideout falls under siege. While on guard, JB receives a startling claim that rattles him.

Episodes.Title: Kings
Episodes.Description: Miguel lashes out at the team when they face the fallout from the attack on their hideout. Later, JB considers his next steps with his father in mind.

Episodes.Title: Corner
Episodes.Description: As the Escaleras conduct their illegal ring, Andres trails a lead to uncover their location. Elsewhere, Tomas' impulsive good deed backfires on him.

Episodes.Title: Drive
Episodes.Description: Andres prepares for a risky scheme against the Escaleras. As JB recruits Max to hack an encrypted file, a frustrated Gabriela confronts her father.

Episodes.Title: Underdogs
Episodes.Description: Andres' stakeout goes south, prompting him to regroup and seek help from JB. Meanwhile, Gabriela makes a crafty move to bail Tomas out of a jam.

Episodes.Title: Double Trouble
Episodes.Description: Facing a hurdle, JB contacts Max for help on Andres' scheme. Tomas works a side job for Gabriela while Miguel makes a desperate play for his son.

Episodes.Title: Ransack
Episodes.Description: When Andres launches his scheme against the Escaleras with his team, they fall into a trap. Tomas finally learns what he must retrieve for Gabriela.

Episodes.Title: Unforgiven
Episodes.Description: Max struggles with a major tech issue while Gabriela finishes Tomas' mission. Elsewhere, Miguel gets into an altercation with Christine's new partner.

Episodes.Title: Hotel
Episodes.Description: While Andres makes necessary preparations before a violent showdown, a pleasant hotel faces serious trouble from a charismatic figure.

Episodes.Title: Detected
Episodes.Description: Greg accepts a contract from an old ally and briefs the team on their new mission: rescue a hotel from the grips of a shadowy leader named Rema Muñoz.

Episodes.Title: Trap
Episodes.Description: The team deals with turmoil as they prepare for their mission. Meanwhile, workers and guests at the hotel scramble for safety from Muñoz's followers.

Episodes.Title: Detected
Episodes.Description: The team races to stop Muñoz's men before more hostages die, while the Escalera gang hunts for Clover's phone to track who stole the master list.

Episodes.Title: Back Up
Episodes.Description: Despite being cautious, Rema's group finds out about the team's operation. The mission gets complicated when an unexpected backup arrives.

Episodes.Title: Sacrifice
Episodes.Description: Tomas works to help a pregnant woman, while JB attempts to to reunite a hostage with her husband. Police intervention at the hotel adds new challenges.

Episodes.Title: Together
Episodes.Description: Andres helps Tomas with a hostage, while Gabriela discovers a group of students who refuse to leave without their coach.

Episodes.Title: Delivery
Episodes.Description: Things heat up when the Escalera gang closes in on the location. Miguel guides Andres as the pregnant hostage goes into labor.

Episodes.Title: Devotion
Episodes.Description: Muñoz's subordinates attempt to jeopardize the mission, but help arrives in time. A life hangs in the balance as Miguel faces a harrowing dilemma.

Episodes.Title: Ring
Episodes.Description: Max enters the hotel to assist in the mission but soon realizes her ring is missing. As the team evacuates hostages, the Escalera gang makes their move.

Episodes.Title: Sinners
Episodes.Description: Muñoz's plan begins to collapse when a follower questions his actions. The cult leader initiates the countdown of the bombs around the hotel.

Episodes.Title: Half Truth
Episodes.Description: As the team rushes to free the remaining hostages, JB and Miguel work to defuse the bombs. Andres and Muñoz face off in a tense showdown.

Episodes.Title: Swords
Episodes.Description: Andres asks Max for the hard drive, promising to deal with the tracker. Greg reveals to Col. Locsin that he knows about Sen. Lacosta's deal with Muñoz.

Episodes.Title: Source
Episodes.Description: The Escaleras keep searching for the thief while Andres checks the master list for his brother. Greg gets a tip about what happened at the safe house.

Episodes.Title: Betrayal
Episodes.Description: After receiving key intel, JB confronts his father about the intruders and his tattoo. Gabriela storms her dad's house to ask about Tomas.

Episodes.Title: No Escape
Episodes.Description: JB blocks Andres from talking to his father about the Escaleras. Meanwhile, Greg's new contract threatens to expose the safehouse siege.

Episodes.Title: Close to Home
Episodes.Description: Max panics after JB reveals Greg's new contract, especially with Andres out of reach — unaware that he's infiltrated Isabel Escalera's quarters.

Episodes.Title: Compadre
Episodes.Description: As the Escaleras meet at Isabel's to discuss the master list, JB and Andres clash over the hard drive. Miguel fears he's being followed.

Episodes.Title: Head
Episodes.Description: After Andres asks JB for more time with the hard drive, Greg discusses the new contract with him. Miguel tries to make amends with his family.

Episodes.Title: Lifeline
Episodes.Description: Time is running out for Andres as Greg orders the team to find Isabel. He enters a high-stakes negotiation with the Escalera matriarch.

Episodes.Title: The Killing List
Episodes.Description: A string of high-profile assassinations sparks tension within the Escalera family. Isabel blackmails Andres to get the hard drive back.

Episodes.Title: Rogue Protector
Episodes.Description: The team zeroes in on Diamond and the gang, but as assailants arrive on the scene, Andres must make a confession. JB rushes to protect his father.

Episodes.Title: Departure
Episodes.Description: Andres tries to evade the mystery attackers and get Isabel to safety. JB defends his father while the rest of the team continues the mission.

Episodes.Title: Mad Man
Episodes.Description: While Andres helps Isabel escape, she entrusts him with a message. Max reveals the truth about the hard drive to Greg.

Episodes.Title: Face the Music
Episodes.Description: After the mission ends, Greg and JB have a heart-to-heart about the hard drive and Andres. Meanwhile, masked men abduct Miguel.

Episodes.Title: Crackdown
Episodes.Description: Greg goes through Andres' file, while Gabriela confronts her father after he sells a beloved house. JB vows to take down the Elcano organization.

Episodes.Title: No Surrender
Episodes.Description: Max returns her fiance's ring to his mother, leading to a heartfelt conversation. Andres faces the team after the fallout of their last mission.

Episodes.Title: Brand New Day
Episodes.Description: Greg takes on a contract to take down Sameo Patel, a drug trafficker with suspicious ties. Andres considers buying back his family's land.

Episodes.Title: Mountain
Episodes.Description: A bad investment forces Tomas' godfather into hiding. Miguel tightens security around Christine and his son. JB leads the team into their mission.

Episodes.Title: Tropic Storm
Episodes.Description: While the team camps near a village, Miguel sees Sameo's subordinates heading for their campsite. Greg learns the truth about his friend.

Episodes.Title: Passage
Episodes.Description: Andres send guards to protect his family, but his grandmother is weary. Meanwhile, a storm arrives as the team heads to Sameo's stronghold.

Episodes.Title: Storage
Episodes.Description: The team pushes to complete the mission in heavy rain and Greg talks to Claire — his friend's wife — about what happened to her husband.

Episodes.Title: Loot
Episodes.Description: After clearing the hideout, the team splits up on route to the exit point. But a young member of Sameo's gang soon warns the others.

Episodes.Title: Desperados
Episodes.Description: On the way out of Mt. Talimba, Andres and Miguel discuss their financial needs while Max and Gabriela search for their missing horse, while JB and Tomas realize that they are being hunted.

Episodes.Title: Boy
Episodes.Description: Andres and Miguel try to make a daring rescue. Max and Gabriela search for their missing horse, while JB and Tomas realize that they are being hunted.

Episodes.Title: Money Matters
Episodes.Description: Andres wrestles with guilt over leaving the girl behind, while Tomas and JB struggle with the long journey and reflect on the past.

Episodes.Title: Intentions
Episodes.Description: A villager sees Andres and Miguel and seeks medical assistance. Meanwhile, Rita finds her brother, but he won't leave until he finds the intruders.

Episodes.Title: Gray Area
Episodes.Description: JB and Timas hide from Sameo's gang, while a hiker's scream briefly pulls Gabriela and Max away from their bags of money.

Episodes.Title: Cash Flow
Episodes.Description: As Andres and Miguel exchange fire with Emer, JB and Tomas escape from their assailants. Meanwhile, Max and Gabriela discover a devious trick.

Episodes.Title: Payback
Episodes.Description: While searching for the two hikers, Max and Gabriela face off against Benjie and his men. Andres assists a wounded Miguel.

Episodes.Title: All for the Family
Episodes.Description: Andres' grandmother confronts him about the money, while Gabriela gives her dad part of the payment for the old house, sparking an emotional talk.

Episodes.Title: Secret Contact
Episodes.Description: As Miguel and Christine talk about their son's future, Max gives back an orphanage and Greg unexpectedly turns down a contract.

Episodes.Title: Checking In
Episodes.Description: Gabriela has Tomas spy on her father's mistress. Meanwhile, Greg mulls over Isabel's last words as Andres hunts for a lead on his brother.

Episodes.Title: Option
Episodes.Description: Unable to reach Miguel, Greg briefs the team without him on their next mission: to capture assasssin Kenji Lee and find out who hired him.

Episodes.Title: Kaigen
Episodes.Description: With his father's condition worsening under custody, JB grows more determined to free him as the team gets ready to go to Kaigen in pursuit of Kenji.

Episodes.Title: Snowfall
Episodes.Description: While the team adjusts to the cold, they realize they're not the only ones hunting Kenji. With his family in peril, Miguel seeks help from Andres.

Episodes.Title: Bad Weather
Episodes.Description: As Greg reunites with and old friend, Max gets an important phone call while Gabriela decides to split from Tomas to survey the area in peace.

Episodes.Title: Eye of the Storm
Episodes.Description: While looking for Gabriela, the team shifts focus when Andres spots Kenji. Back in the Philippines, Miguel shakes off his family's stalkers.

Episodes.Title: Frozen
Episodes.Description: Greg talks to a despondent Andres after the team hits a snag in the mission. Tomas opens up about his brother, while Max's news to gives hope to JB.

Episodes.Title: Snow Drift
Episodes.Description: As Max talks to Andres about loss and moving on, JB reflects on his last conversation with his father. Meanwhile, Miguel prepares for a showdown.

Episodes.Title: Slippery Slope
Episodes.Description: JB trails Kenji on a daring snowmobile chase as the rest of the team closes in. But things get complicated when the local mafia joins the hunt.

Episodes.Title: Blood on the Snow
Episodes.Description: To find Kenji, Max uses city cameras and tracks him down. Andres' grandmother goes to the agency to confirm the news about Jun.

Episodes.Title: Cold Blood
Episodes.Description: Unable to move due to his condition, JB helplessly watches as Tomas fends off the Rai Jins alone. Meanwhile, Miguel continues his onslaught.

Episodes.Title: Departures
Episodes.Description: Rattled by Kenji's words, the team questions whether they should complete the contract or not. Greg makes a call to determine their course of action.

Episodes.Title: Traitors
Episodes.Description: As Andres reunites with his family, he and his grandmother discuss their suspicions about Jun. Elsewhere, Max voices concerns about JB's father's case.

Episodes.Title: Enduring Love
Episodes.Description: After the Kaigen mission, the team reunites for another get-together with Miguel. Later, Andres' grandmother urges him to move on from his search.

Episodes.Title: One Step Closer
Episodes.Description: JB turns into a violent as he pursues the man who conned him. Tomas goes on his first date with Agnes, while Gab confronts Shari at a yoga class.

Episodes.Title: Love and Drugs
Episodes.Description: A meeting with a young man raises new suspicions for Andres. As Gabriela breaks down over her mother's death, her father issues an ultimatum.

Episodes.Title: Bad Ideas
Episodes.Description: Gabriela struggles to reclaim her mother's resthouse, but Tomas has an idea. JB and Max continue plotting against the El Cano group.

Episodes.Title: Contractfully Yours
Episodes.Description: JB and Max get a possible lead on the El Cano organization. Tomas tells Ninong about his deal with Gabriela, while Gab speaks to her father.

Episodes.Title: Brother
Episodes.Description: While Greg searches for Raven, he remembers the mission that cost him his team their lives. Gabriela's father confronts Tomas, questioning his intentions.

Episodes.Title: Promises to Keep
Episodes.Description: After Dexter's meet-up with Manuel, JB and Max tail the target's car. Gabriela and Tomas move forward with their plan under her father's watchful eye.

Episodes.Title: Suspicions
Episodes.Description: As a celebration unfolds in Andres' home, Gabriela and Tomas endure an awkward dinner with her father and Ninong as they try not to blow their cover.

Episodes.Title: Collision Course
Episodes.Description: Unfazed by Diego's odd behavior, Andres talks to his grandmother about reclaiming their land. The next day, Greg briefs the team on their new mission.

Episodes.Title: At All Costs
Episodes.Description: Seeking to trail Diego, JB and Greg keep watch on Andres, while Max and Miguel comb through an event's guest list for suspicious names.

Episodes.Title: Home
Episodes.Description: As Andres confronts Diego about whether he's been avoiding him, Gabriela grows emotional over an unexpected gift from her father.

Episodes.Title: Meet Up
Episodes.Description: After clashing with Greg, Andres cools off with JB's help as the three reach a compromise on the mission. Meanwhile, Tomas runs into and old classmate.

Episodes.Title: Hunted
Episodes.Description: When the target leaves after meeting Andres, Greg and JB follow him to his base. Elsewhere, Gabriela presses Tomas about a woman he was seen with.

Episodes.Title: Gathering
Episodes.Description: As a charity event begins, the team prepares for the mission head of Sec. Barrios' arrival. Buth they might not be the only ones surveilling the area.

Episodes.Title: The Uninvited
Episodes.Description: The team scrambles when an unexpected guest arrives but they continue to prioritize the target. Gabriela confronts a potentially compromised Tomas.

Episodes.Title: Party at High Noon
Episodes.Description: While Diego executes his group's plans, Max notifies her team about an unusual activity at the party. Greg and his former comrade corner Manuel at an unlikely place in an attempt to settle old scores.

Episodes.Title: Death is Calling
Episodes.Description: The mission grows complicated when Miguel mistakes a musician for a threat and Sec. Barrios veers off-program. Meanwhile, Greg confronts on an old friend.

Episodes.Title: In Plain Sight
Episodes.Description: Fearing for Ninong's life, Tomas follows the orders of an unknown caller. Max fills Greg in on the unexpected guest and Miguel's theory about the mix-up.

Episodes.Title: Panic Room
Episodes.Description: When an emergency occurs at the event, the team grows concerned when Tomas begins acting suspiciously, prompting Andres to tail him.

Episodes.Title: Puppeteer
Episodes.Description: Torn between completing the mission and protecting Tomas, the team decides to split up. Gabriela goes to help Ninong after Max gives her potential leads.

Episodes.Title: The Decision to Kill
Episodes.Description: As Gabriela continues to search for Ninong, the caller gives Tomas a shocking directive, Meanwhile, Max tells Greg about the snag mission.

Episodes.Title: Done For
Episodes.Description: The clock is ticking as Andres tries to stop the caller from pushing through with the plan, while Tomas moves to fulfill the final command.

Episodes.Title: Crossfire
Episodes.Description: A hallway shootout results in multiple casualties — and one hits close to home for Andres. Max, Tomas and Miguel rush to evacuate the area.

Episodes.Title: Devastation
Episodes.Description: As the team scrambles to get urgent medical care for the shootout victims, Miguel rushes to Andres' side while he anxiously waits for an update.

Episodes.Title: The Dead and the Dying
Episodes.Description: When Tomas mentions backing out of his job, he and Gabriela get some advice. Meanwhile, Miguel tries to support Andres through a difficult time.

Episodes.Title: Sudden Impact
Episodes.Description: While Andres confronts Manuel about the shootout, Tomas joins Gabriela to meet her father, but a surprise encounter with an armed man derails their plan.

Episodes.Title: What You Wish For
Episodes.Description: Greg arrives at Andres' home to pay respects, but meets resistance. Andres works to buy his family's land and JB seeks to keep his injuries a secret.

Episodes.Title: All Said and Done
Episodes.Description: Andres' grandmother urges him to let go of the past, while JB shares good news with his father. Missing his family, Miguel marks an important milestone.

Episodes.Title: Death on the Horizon
Episodes.Description: While Andres and his family celebrate with the community, Gabriela is caught off guard when she sees her father calling Tomas phone.

Episodes.Title: Fall Out
Episodes.Description: Tomas gets surprising news from Ninong, urging him to return home. A child delivers a suspicious package to Max's house as JB goes to pick up his father.

Episodes.Title: The Killing Time
Episodes.Description: After receiving news of a threat, the team realizes they might not be the only targets and frantically rush home to protect their loved ones.

Episodes.Title: Bloodshed
Episodes.Description: Manuel's plan swings into action, sending the team reeling. Noticing his silence, Andres' grandmother asks if he misses life in the city.

Episodes.Title: Vendetta
Episodes.Description: While Greg and Miguel keep watch over a devastated Max, Gabriela tries to make amends with her father before it's too late.

Episodes.Title: No Turning Back
Episodes.Description: After an emotional update from Miguel about the state of the team following the Barrios mission, Andres agrees to meet with Greg.

Episodes.Title: Bullets
Episodes.Description: Greg calls in reinforcements as the team prepares to launch their attack on Manuel's potential stronghold while rescuing the children imprisoned there.

Episodes.Title: War
Episodes.Description: Ahead of the strike, Greg and the team air out their grief and grievances as they come to terms with the cost of their mission.

Episodes.Title: Split
Episodes.Description: Andres and JB reconcile over their losses. After witnessing cruelty at the stronghold, Tomas and Gabriela wants to act, but Miguel urges caution.

Episodes.Title: We Move as a Team
Episodes.Description: The team carefully advances through the stronghold. But before they can attempt their strike, Andres must reach the kidnapped children.

Episodes.Title: Get Your Guns Out
Episodes.Description: Max lands in trouble when El Cano operatives swarm around her, while Andres' team discovers there are more children being held captive.

Episodes.Title: Heart of Darkness
Episodes.Description: Caught in a perilous shoot-out, Gabriel and Tomas take a moment to make peace. Meanwhile, Andres attempts to honor a child's request.

Episodes.Title: This Time for Heroes
Episodes.Description: Greg and the gang try to lure Manuel and the rest of El Cano out with threats of gunfire. But when they're nowhere to be seen, the team gets suspicious.

Episodes.Title: Bad Time to Die
Episodes.Description: Danger continues as the team spots bomb traps in the buildings. Greg realizes the El Cano is using a sinister weapon for deadly attacks.

Episodes.Title: Kontraktwalistas
Episodes.Description: Andres and Tomas attempt to rescue a teammate in trouble as El Cano forces threaten to gun them down. JB's condition puts him and Max in a bind.

Episodes.Title: Redemption
Episodes.Description: As JB and Max try to escape El Cano operatives, they must fend off Manuel's right hand man. Meanwhile Miguel helps out Gabriela.

Episodes.Title: Exit Point
Episodes.Description: While JB and Max continue the fight against Manuel's henchman, Greg confronts an old friend to finish the mission once and for all.

Episodes.Title: Love and Honor
Episodes.Description: As Greg vows to take down El Cano, Gabriela discuss their relationship, while Andres gets a visitor he wasn't expecting.

Entries.Title: Encantadia
Entries.Description: Four sisters – Pirena, Amihan, Alena, and Danaya — guard the gems that hold the power to maintain peace and harmony in the world of Encantadia. Their bond is broken when Pirena discovers that their mother is afraid of her desire to become the queen of Encantadia.

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: A mystical realm unfolds as ancient powers stir and long-held alliances are tested. A dangerous threat emerges, sparking a confrontation that shakes the balance of the kingdoms. Amid the chaos, a prophecy begins to take root, destined to reshape the fate of Encantadia.

Episodes.Title: Prophecy
Episodes.Description: As war rages between kingdoms, sacrifices are made that will change the course of Encantadia's future. A child is born under extraordinary signs, sparking new hope and deeper rivalries. Meanwhile, an exiled enemy forges a sinister bond in the shadows.

Episodes.Title: Curse of Mine-a
Episodes.Description: Tensions rise as old grudges threaten the fragile peace in Lireo. A dark plot unfolds, placing the kingdom’s youngest heir in mortal danger. But when vengeance clashes with power, a new curse reshapes the fate of an entire kingdom.

Episodes.Title: Warning
Episodes.Description: As the Hathors suffer the wrath of a powerful curse, a dark alliance is born in the shadows of ruin. To protect her daughter, Minea sends Raquim and Amihan through the portal to the human world. But even beyond Encantadia, danger lurks—and a fateful encounter changes Raquim's journey forever.

Episodes.Title: Mortal
Episodes.Description: In the human world, Raquim raises Amihan in secret while adapting to a life among mortals. But whispers of their otherworldly nature begin to stir suspicion in the village. Back in Encantadia, Hagorn intensifies his hunt for the key to the portal—and Gurna may be closer than ever.

Episodes.Title: Confession
Episodes.Description: Amihan grows up in hiding with Raquim in the human world, but their peaceful life is shattered when danger finds them. As suspicions rise among the villagers, the threat from Encantadia draws ever closer. Back in Lireo, a betrayal opens the portal, and the Hathors march once more.

Episodes.Title: Reckoning
Episodes.Description: Amihan and Raquim's peaceful life is destroyed when the Hathors attack, leading to a fateful confrontation. As Raquim falls, Amihan is brought back to Encantadia—wounded and unsure of the truth. In Lireo, old wounds are reopened as Minea prepares to reunite her daughters.

Episodes.Title: Avisala Sang'gres
Episodes.Description: As Amihan reunites with her family, Pirena struggles with jealousy and a painful revelation about her origins. While the Sang’gres face danger beyond the palace walls, dark influences continue to pull Pirena away from her sisters. Secrets, loyalties, and legacies begin to reshape the future of Lireo.

Episodes.Title: Test
Episodes.Description: With Minea preparing to name her successor, tensions rise as the Sang’gres begin to compete for the throne. Pirena grows increasingly bitter upon learning her mother’s hidden doubts, while Amihan and Alena share a quiet moment of sisterhood. Meanwhile, a charming stranger crosses paths with a bathing diwata—unaware their meeting may change his destiny forever.

Episodes.Title: Competition
Episodes.Description: The Sang’gres face a mysterious woman in white, whose defeat will determine the next queen of Lireo. Tensions peak as Pirena’s ambition drives her to betray Amihan in the middle of battle. When the true meaning of the trial is revealed, the unexpected choice of queen ignites fury—and a dangerous challenge—from within the royal family.

Episodes.Title: Wrath of Pirena
Episodes.Description: Pirena breaks away from her family, stealing the Fire Gem and turning to Hathoria for vengeance. As darkness spreads across Encantadia, Minea entrusts the remaining gems to her daughters to safeguard the realm. With war looming, Amihan is crowned queen—sworn to lead and protect all of Encantadia.

Episodes.Title: Confrontation
Episodes.Description: As war erupts between the Hathors and the kingdoms of Encantadia, Pirena leads the enemy, torn between rage and remorse. Amid the chaos, Amihan confronts both Hagorn and Pirena in battle—and spares her sister despite betrayal. With the Fire Gem in Pirena's grasp, Amihan's compassion is tested at the edge of a blade.

Episodes.Title: Feelings
Episodes.Description: The Sang’gres unleash the power of their gems to drive back the Hathors, with Pirena hesitating at the brink of betrayal. As peace briefly returns, the guardians of Lireo seek an heir for Amihan—and the divine white butterfly begins its search. In the quiet that follows war, fate flutters toward Ybarro, as a sign from Emre marks him for a destiny greater than he imagined.

Episodes.Title: The Destined
Episodes.Description: As Amihan dreams of a mysterious suitor, a sign from Emre marks the beginning of a divine pregnancy. Alena deepens her bond with Ybarro, unaware that he may be more entwined with destiny than he realizes. Meanwhile, Pirena enacts a dark scheme—ensuring her part in the prophecy while plotting against her unborn rival.

Episodes.Title: Truth
Episodes.Description: As Amihan confirms her dream's meaning and struggles with royal laws, Alena fights for her love against tradition. In the shadows, Agane’s assassination attempt finds an unexpected target. Amid joy, longing, and looming danger, the first cracks form in the House of Lireo.

Episodes.Title: Avisala Lira and Mira
Episodes.Description: As Lireo mourns the sudden death of Queen Minea, two new heirs are born—Amihan's daughter Lira, and Pirena’s secret child. Grief and suspicion ripple through the kingdom, while Pirena unexpectedly returns, claiming to seek peace. But behind every show of remorse, darker plans continue to unfold.

Episodes.Title: Return
Episodes.Description: As Amihan spares Pirena's life in the name of forgiveness, doubts and tensions rise among the sisters. Danaya and Alena take magical steps to protect newborn Lira—unaware of Pirena's secret plan to swap the infants. While Amihan begins to feel a mysterious bond pulling her toward her child, darkness stirs in Balaak as Adhara begins her deadly quest for rebirth.

Episodes.Title: Danger
Episodes.Description: As Pirena secretly banishes baby Lira to the human world, Muyak follows to protect her. Amihan confesses to Ybarro that he is the child's father, but urges him to stay away. Meanwhile, Lira is found by a kind couple in the mortal realm, while Danaya grows increasingly suspicious of Pirena's motives.

Episodes.Title: Mission
Episodes.Description: Pirena completes her deception, secretly abandoning Lira in the mortal world, where she is taken in by a kind couple and named Milagros. In Lireo, tensions grow as suspicions about Minea’s true killer stir, and Alena reels from a painful breakup with Ybarro. Meanwhile, Asval hunts for a powerful key, and a mysterious warning hints at Lira’s extraordinary destiny.

Episodes.Title: Intuition
Episodes.Description: As Mira celebrates her enchanted birthday in Lireo, Mila faces grief and blame in the mortal world after a tragic accident. The divide between the two girls grows wider, even as signs of Mila's true heritage begin to emerge. Meanwhile, Amihan grows increasingly unsettled by dreams of a daughter who doesn’t look like Mira.

Episodes.Title: Origin
Episodes.Description: Mila learns the truth about her heritage and calls out to her real mother, unaware that Amihan struggles with doubts about Mira. As Berto’s paranoia escalates, Amanda begins to question his sanity and her own judgments. In Encantadia, Ybarro’s mysterious powers surface during a battle, drawing dangerous attention from Asval and his men.

Episodes.Title: Secret
Episodes.Description: Ybarro learns the shocking truth about his royal lineage and sets out to rediscover his past. Amihan and her forces confront increasing Hathor aggression while sensing a ghostly presence that stirs old fears. In the mortal world, Amanda and Mila reconcile, while Berto makes an unexpected gesture of remorse.

Episodes.Title: Pagaspas
Episodes.Description: Ybarro explores the ruins of Sapiro, unknowingly watched by enemies who seek to end his life. As Amihan summons aid from the Mulawin to bring Ybarro back, secrets and regrets ripple through Lireo's court. Meanwhile, Pirena discovers a powerful truth that could destroy her sister’s happiness.

Episodes.Title: Showdown
Episodes.Description: As Ybarro confronts death and betrayal, Cassiopea’s intervention offers him a second chance—and a powerful revelation. In Lireo, Amihan grapples with truths that could shatter her sister’s heart, while Pirena plots quietly with dangerous knowledge in hand. A fateful reunion awaits in the ruins of Sapiro, where Ybarro comes face to face with a figure from his past.

Episodes.Title: Meeting
Episodes.Description: Ybarro, now bearing the armor and legacy of his father, begins his secret mission under a new name. As Alena clings to hope, Pirena moves forward with hidden ambitions, her Fire Gem once more in hand. Meanwhile, Mira faces pressure to rise as heir, even as a mysterious figure claims she has long been awaited.

Episodes.Title: Fate
Episodes.Description: Mira learns of a mysterious stranger who could change her destiny, leading her to question her future as queen. As Amihan and Pirena clash over matters of love and legacy, Mila’s growing powers draw dangerous attention from Berto. In both worlds, fates begin to entwine, and secrets stir that could alter the balance of Encantadia.

Episodes.Title: Destiny
Episodes.Description: Mira escapes to the human world in search of answers, prompting Amihan to follow her through the portal with Mila's unexpected help. As new connections form between Mira and Anthony, Pirena grows increasingly suspicious of Mira's intentions. Meanwhile, Cassiopea's cryptic prophecy continues to shake the destinies of both Lireo and the mortal realm.

Episodes.Title: Suspicion
Episodes.Description: As Mila struggles with a desperate decision to save Amanda, she unknowingly reveals her true identity. Pirena journeys to the mortal world and confirms the existence of the lost Sang'gre. Meanwhile, danger looms as a new enemy threatens the Encantados, and trust begins to falter among the sisters.

Episodes.Title: Waiting
Episodes.Description: Mila learns the truth of her heritage, but her encounter with Pirena turns deadly. As Amihan's court debates Mira's readiness to rule, Alena returns with grim news. Meanwhile, a powerful dark force continues its rise, threatening to alter the fate of Encantadia.

Episodes.Title: Avisala Vish'ka
Episodes.Description: As Adhara resurfaces and begins forging a new path to vengeance, Encantadia’s past reveals dark secrets that shaped the realm. Pirena and Mira each face rejection in their pursuit of power, while Alena battles grief that threatens to consume her. In the shadows, alliances shift—setting the stage for chaos yet to come.

Episodes.Title: Deception
Episodes.Description: Mira grapples with her identity and future as tensions rise within Lireo over the next heir. While Mila faces harsh realities in the mortal world, Pirena sets her sights on eliminating her rivals. Meanwhile, Alena takes a drastic step to escape her heartache—unaware of the danger that follows.

Episodes.Title: Attack
Episodes.Description: Amihan grows increasingly worried as the search for Alena continues, leading her to seek Cassiopea’s guidance. Meanwhile, tensions rise between the Sang’gres as suspicion brews over Pirena’s role in Alena’s disappearance. In the mortal world, Amanda takes a bold step to protect Mila, while Anthony struggles with his growing concern for her.

Episodes.Title: Wrath
Episodes.Description: As the realm mourns a tragic loss, old wounds and suspicions surface, deepening the rift among the Sang’gres. In the mortal world, Mila and Amanda confront the harsh realities of their situation, while mysterious memories and marks begin to reveal deeper truths. Meanwhile, a dangerous plan unfolds as Pirena sets a new scheme into motion that could threaten both worlds.

Episodes.Title: Adversary
Episodes.Description: As one sister grieves and searches for truth, another begins to unravel a hidden past in a strange new world. Trust starts to fracture within Lireo’s walls, even as danger hides in plain sight. Meanwhile, a sinister plot quietly unfolds, threatening the fragile balance of power.

Episodes.Title: Investigation
Episodes.Description: As Danaya continues her quest for truth, new accusations threaten to divide the kingdom from within. In the mortal world, Akesha uncovers more clues about her identity while danger lurks close to home. Meanwhile, secrets and schemes unfold across realms, placing allies under suspicion and old wounds on the verge of reopening.

Episodes.Title: Accusation
Episodes.Description: Ybarro's true identity begins to unfold as he faces the warriors of Sapiro. In Lireo, Danaya continues to fight for her innocence while Pirena executes a dangerous plan to secure her ambitions. Meanwhile, Mila finds herself caught between office politics and a growing connection with Anthony.

Episodes.Title: Sentence
Episodes.Description: Mira begins to doubt Pirena after learning the truth about her past. As Danaya faces punishment for a crime she insists she didn’t commit, Amihan struggles with the burden of leadership. Meanwhile, Pirena manipulates events to take charge of Danaya’s exile, while Mira silently watches her schemes unfold.

Episodes.Title: Fight
Episodes.Description: Danaya begins her exile in the human world, escorted by someone she least expected. Tensions rise in Lireo as suspicions of betrayal and imposture deepen among the Sang’gres. Meanwhile, Mira confronts troubling truths about her identity and loyalty, as Mila faces a difficult choice that could expose her secret.

Episodes.Title: Threat
Episodes.Description: Mila faces a moral dilemma when Berto forces her into a dangerous situation that could reveal her true identity. In the human world, Danaya struggles to return to Encantadia, while a fateful encounter hints at long-buried truths. Meanwhile, tensions escalate in Lireo as alliances shift and secrets threaten to unravel the balance of power.

Episodes.Title: Longing
Episodes.Description: Mila begins to push back against Berto's threats, unaware that her true identity has already placed her in danger. As Enuo’s past comes to light, Danaya's presence in the human world attracts powerful enemies. In Lireo, Pirena continues her schemes, even resorting to deception that could shake the kingdom's trust in its queen.

Episodes.Title: Dream
Episodes.Description: Pirena escalates her deception by impersonating Amihan and sowing dissent among Lireo’s people. In the human world, Danaya is gravely wounded while protecting innocents from Hagorn, only to be rescued by a mysterious man named Enuo. As Amihan grows suspicious of recent events, Mira finds herself caught between truth and loyalty when Cassiopea warns of an impending downfall.

Episodes.Title: Conspiracy
Episodes.Description: Pirena sabotages Lireo’s defenses using the Fire Gem and silences Mira when her daughter questions her loyalty. In the mortal realm, Akesha begins to recall pieces of her past while Mila and Muyak continue their search for Alena. As Ybarro rushes to warn Amihan, Hagorn prepares the Hathors for a full-scale assault, hiding his true intentions from his supposed ally, Pirena.

Episodes.Title: Signal
Episodes.Description: As the twin moons align, Pirena and Hagorn launch a coordinated assault on Lireo, igniting a civil war within the kingdom. Danaya learns of a dangerous way back to Encantadia, while Amihan attempts to save Mira using the Scepter of Minea—only to be branded a traitor and arrested. In the mortal realm, Mila searches for Akesha, unaware that a greater battle is already raging in her homeland.

Episodes.Title: Battle
Episodes.Description: As chaos reigns in Lireo, Amihan uses the Air Gem to repel the invaders—but the spell nearly kills Mira, revealing a shocking truth about her heritage. Pirena and Hagorn take control of the palace, while Amihan escapes with Imaw, wounded but determined. Meanwhile, Ybarro, Aquil, and the loyalists regroup to resist the occupation, and Mila closes in on Akesha’s location in the mortal world.

Episodes.Title: For Lireo
Episodes.Description: As Lireo falls, Mira escapes Gurna and entrusts Minea’s scepter to loyalist soldiers before fleeing the palace. Ybarro buys time for Mira’s escape by battling Asval and his men, while Amihan suffers mortal wounds at the hands of Hagorn, Pirena, and Agane. In the mortal world, Danaya prepares to cross back into Encantadia—knowing it will come at a human cost.

Episodes.Title: The Fifth Brilyante
Episodes.Description: Hagorn crowns Pirena as queen of Lireo, and she is shocked to learn that he is her true father. While the loyalists regroup in the mandirigma camp, Paopao secretly heals Amihan with the Fifth Gem but draws attention by revealing his powers. Mira escapes to the mortal world, setting off a new hunt as Hagorn orders Paopao's capture.

Episodes.Title: Threat
Episodes.Description: As Berto tries to have Mila killed, Amanda sacrifices her life to protect her, forcing Mila and Muyak to flee. Meanwhile, Amihan reunites with the loyalists at the mandirigma camp and introduces Paopao, whose mysterious powers are linked to the Fifth Gem. In Lireo, Pirena tightens her grip on power and threatens to execute the captives unless Amihan and her allies surrender.

Episodes.Title: Avisala Lakan
Episodes.Description: Amihan dons a disguise to rescue the captive loyalists in Lireo, but Pirena and Hagorn are quick to intercept her. Meanwhile, Danaya and Muyak continue their search for Mila, learning from each other about Lira’s true identity. As chaos builds in both worlds, a mysterious warrior named Lakan intervenes just in time to help Danaya and disappears without a trace.

Episodes.Title: Flight
Episodes.Description: Amihan rescues some captives from Lireo, but the brutal death of Ades and others weighs heavily on her. Mila and Mira finally meet and uncover the truth about their origins, forging a new bond between them. Meanwhile, Danaya learns the identity of her father and prepares to find the mysterious Mulawin, as Pirena begins plotting new alliances to secure her power.

Episodes.Title: Ally
Episodes.Description: As Amihan trains Paopao and inspires the refugees in Ascano, Pirena visits Carcero in search of new allies. Mila brings Mira to Anthony’s care, while Danaya prepares to return to Encantadia with Mila as tribute—but their plan fails. As Danaya plays the Flute of Mulawin, a powerful ally awakens, just as Alena’s life hangs in the balance among the bandidos.

Episodes.Title: Ability
Episodes.Description: As Danaya, Lira, and Lakan brave a perilous journey back to Encantadia, Pirena uncovers the tale of Adhara’s uprising in Carcero. In the mortal world, Paopao is captured by bandidos—only to unlock his hidden power and transform into a formidable warrior. Asval begins a new pursuit of the escaped loyalists, while Amihan marvels at the strength awakened by the Fifth Gem.

Episodes.Title: New Challenge
Episodes.Description: Lakan reveals the painful past that led him to the human world, while Adhara is forced to face the mysterious and dangerous LilaSari in a deadly match at Carcero. Paopao reverts to his young self after tapping into the Fifth Gem’s power, and Amihan brings him back to camp. Meanwhile, Hagorn welcomes new allies to Lireo, vowing destruction to any who oppose him—including the elusive Mulawins.

Episodes.Title: Ferocity of Lakan
Episodes.Description: Adhara leads a rebellion in Carcero, winning over LilaSari and defeating Orthana, as the prisoners rise up and escape toward Ayleb. In the mortal realm, Lira and Lakan brave the treacherous skies between worlds, but their journey takes a perilous turn when Lira suddenly faints mid-flight. Meanwhile, Amihan grieves the loss of the taong ligaw and steels herself as new threats close in from all sides.

Episodes.Title: Savior
Episodes.Description: Lira’s journey through danger continues as she and Danaya finally return to the land of Encantadia. Meanwhile, a fierce battle erupts between former allies, and a surprising new force enters the fight. As destinies shift, ancient powers awaken to prepare for what’s to come.

Episodes.Title: Memory
Episodes.Description: As Danaya and Lira begin their perilous journey across Encantadia, long-lost truths and hidden powers come to light. Meanwhile, a powerful survivor rises from the ashes of tragedy to seek justice. Tensions rise as the battle lines continue to shift, and destiny draws key players ever closer together.

Episodes.Title: Match
Episodes.Description: As Danaya takes on a wild challenge to secure aid for Lira’s journey, unexpected consequences arise. Alena begins to recover fragments of a forgotten past, while danger stirs once more in the shadows of Avalon. With loyalties shifting and identities emerging, new sparks of conflict ignite across Encantadia.

Episodes.Title: Encounter
Episodes.Description: Lira, Danaya, and Wantuk attempt to escape captivity, but their mission is further complicated by an unexpected clash with the Hathors. Alena makes her presence known in Encantadia, rekindling old ties while trying to evade her enemies. As danger mounts and loyalties are tested, a devastating confrontation leaves a beloved ally hanging between life and death.

Episodes.Title: Way
Episodes.Description: As Danaya refuses to surrender hope, she and Lakan embark on a perilous quest to retrieve a legendary artifact that may save Lira’s life. In the spirit realm, Lira confronts the truth of her death and the looming finality of Devas. Meanwhile, Vish’ka faces veiled threats from the Hathors, who plot to force Ascano’s allegiance through cunning rather than combat.

Episodes.Title: Deliverance
Episodes.Description: As Danaya and Lakan brave a deadly labyrinth for a mythical cure, Lira must confront her fate in the afterlife to prove she is worthy of returning. Meanwhile, a sinister plan unfolds against the unsuspecting Ascanos, and emotions run high as long-separated hearts and loyalties are tested. The balance between truth and deception begins to tilt as alliances shift across Encantadia.

Episodes.Title: Question
Episodes.Description: As alliances crumble and truths are finally revealed, Alena is caught in a storm of betrayal, heartbreak, and an unexpected discovery. Pirena and Hagorn tighten their grip on Lireo, while a devastating loss shakes the barbaros. With danger closing in on all sides, Alena must decide where her loyalty truly lies.

Episodes.Title: Fighting
Episodes.Description: Lira, Danaya, and Wantuk resume their search for Amihan as danger creeps closer. Meanwhile, Alena makes a fateful decision after giving birth, and an unusual young man appears, shrouded in mystery. Unexpected reunions and narrow escapes shape a day filled with magic, peril, and destiny.

Episodes.Title: Reunion
Episodes.Description: As the search for Lira begins, Amihan and Danaya reunite and share long-awaited truths. Lira finds herself in grave danger after placing her trust in the wrong hands. Meanwhile, Pirena hatches a plan that could turn daughter against mother using deception and manipulation.

Episodes.Title: Courage
Episodes.Description: Lira finds herself torn as she reconnects with someone who claims to be her mother, unaware of the deception at play. As Amihan and Danaya close in on Lireo, Pirena sets the stage for a dangerous confrontation. Meanwhile, secrets and schemes unfold on all sides as allies and enemies move closer to collision.

Episodes.Title: Face to Face
Episodes.Description: Amihan and Danaya storm Lireo in search of Lira, but Pirena uses deception and threats to keep her leverage. In the human world, Mira slowly begins to warm up to her new life with Anthony, unaware of the growing danger around her. As secrets unravel and portals are considered, both sides prepare for a clash that could shift the fate of Encantadia.

Episodes.Title: Mother and Child
Episodes.Description: While Lira remains trapped and deceived in Lireo, powerful forces move across Encantadia and the human world to shift the balance. Mira faces danger but is finally reunited with her allies, setting the stage for a daring rescue. As old friends return and new threats rise, a risky plan begins to take shape to save Lira from Pirena's clutches.

Episodes.Title: For the Child
Episodes.Description: As tensions rise, Mira agrees to a painful plan that could save Lira, while secrets from both worlds begin to unravel. A bold retrieval mission takes place within Lireo, and an ancient weapon falls into the wrong hands. When a desperate act shakes everyone, Danaya must rely on nature itself to restore hope.

Episodes.Title: Lilasari's Face
Episodes.Description: As Ybarro returns a powerful relic to its rightful keeper, the threat against Amihan intensifies both in dreams and reality. A terrifying truth is revealed about LilaSari’s curse, while Danaya races to save Mira. Amihan makes a bold move to rescue her daughter—only to fall into a cunning trap.

Episodes.Title: Challenge
Episodes.Description: While Paopao and his allies mount a rescue for Amihan, Hagorn and Pirena close in with brutal tactics. Lira begins to question her reality after a mysterious visitor reveals the truth behind her captivity. Amid betrayal and heartache, Mira decides to walk away from the mothers who’ve both let her down.

Episodes.Title: Attempt
Episodes.Description: Ybarro rescues Amihan from captivity just as Hagorn intensifies his attacks on her allies. As Lira begins to see through Pirena’s deception, Amihan and Ades race against time to save her. Tensions rise within the enemy ranks, and Mira’s departure leaves a lingering ache for the mothers who failed her.

Episodes.Title: Mistake
Episodes.Description: Amihan reunites with Lira at last, only to be stabbed by her daughter, who believes she is Pirena in disguise. As Amihan fights for her life, Ybarro and Ades risk everything to help her escape. Meanwhile, Pirena's alliance with Hagorn begins to fracture, and Lira finally finds a way out of the palace.

Episodes.Title: Blessing
Episodes.Description: Amihan tries to reach out to Lira through the power of the Air Gem, unaware that Lira has been rescued—and manipulated—by Adhara. Imaw fails to locate Alena, as Ether blocks the truth about Kahlil. As Amihan's forces find a more secure refuge, Pirena reflects on her missteps while tensions grow within her own ranks.

Episodes.Title: Pact
Episodes.Description: Hagorn intensifies the hunt for Amihan and her allies as Pirena begins to train Kahlil for a dangerous purpose. Amihan rallies her forces and sends out search parties, unaware that Lira is now in the hands of Adhara and LilaSari. Meanwhile, Cassiopea warns Amihan of a looming threat to her daughter that could change everything.

Episodes.Title: Comrade
Episodes.Description: As Adhara regains her powers and arms herself with the Lupig, she and LilaSari confront Amihan and Pirena in a shocking clash. Lira grows suspicious of her supposed allies, just as tensions deepen within Hagorn’s court. A hidden truth causes Pirena to question her loyalty and her place in her father’s kingdom.

Episodes.Title: Plan
Episodes.Description: Lira struggles with captivity while doubts begin to surface among her captors, especially as emotions from the past are stirred. In Lireo and Hathoria, suspicion and deception deepen as secrets unravel and loyalties are tested. Pirena faces the consequences of a failed betrayal, even as Hagorn begins to suspect the truth behind the attack.

Episodes.Title: Surprise
Episodes.Description: Pirena finds herself in a dangerous game of deception as Hagorn begins to test her loyalty in increasingly perilous ways. Lira's escape leads to more complications, while Ybarro sets out on a journey to unlock Sapiro’s secrets. Meanwhile, unexpected alliances begin to form as powerful forces close in on their enemies from all sides.

Episodes.Title: Persuasion
Episodes.Description: Pirena makes a desperate plea for help against Hagorn, but her past betrayals continue to cast a long shadow. As Amihan prepares a daring mission to rescue Lira, tensions and doubts run high among her allies. Meanwhile, a new threat descends on the camp, forcing everyone to fight for survival.

Episodes.Title: Encounter
Episodes.Description: Amihan closes in on Lira's whereabouts, even as Adhara weaves more lies to protect her secrets. Danaya seeks the truth about Kahlil’s origins, uncovering a revelation that changes everything. As battles erupt on multiple fronts, loyalties are tested and new threats emerge in unexpected places.

Episodes.Title: Trade
Episodes.Description: Amihan challenges Adhara in a fierce duel as tensions rise over Lira’s mysterious disappearance. Meanwhile, Danaya confirms Kahlil’s true identity, and Ybarro is forced to confront a painful possibility. Loyalties shift and long-held secrets unravel as the battle for truth and power escalates.

Episodes.Title: Loan
Episodes.Description: Ybarro seeks a powerful artifact to bargain for Kahlil’s freedom, while Amihan confronts the mysterious force that holds Lira captive. As secrets from the past begin to surface, destinies collide and loyalties are tested. The battle to reunite a family intensifies, even as a goddess stands in the way.

Episodes.Title: Support
Episodes.Description: As Ether and Amihan clash in a battle of will and power, Paopao falls into Hagorn’s hands and is forced to make a devastating choice. The sang’gres struggle to unite and recover what was lost, while tensions rise within their ranks. With war looming and dark forces gathering, alliances must be forged—no matter the cost.

Episodes.Title: Union
Episodes.Description: As Hagorn weds LilaSari and declares her Queen of Lireo, Pirena is stripped of power and forced to face her father's wrath. Meanwhile, Alena’s fate takes a turn as Agua seeks a cure for her transformation, and Ether ominously intervenes in Kahlil's disappearance. With alliances crumbling and threats intensifying, the sisters find themselves more divided—and endangered—than ever.

Episodes.Title: Strength
Episodes.Description: Pirena is stripped of her crown and power as Hagorn takes possession of a third gem and proclaims LilaSari queen with Cassiopea’s crown. Cast out and humiliated, Pirena begins to fight back as her sisters regroup to face Hagorn’s growing threat. As treachery and loyalty are tested on all sides, a defiant Pirena launches a surprise attack, setting the stage for a fiery clash.

Episodes.Title: Request
Episodes.Description: Pirena and Danaya launch a failed attack on Hagorn and are forced to flee, narrowly escaping LilaSari’s hidden powers. As tensions rise among the Sang'gres, alliances shift and old flames resurface, while Danaya and Aquil’s journey for supplies brings an unexpected reunion. Meanwhile, in Old Etheria, Agua risks a fateful choice to restore Alena, as LilaSari uncovers a powerful secret hidden within Hagorn’s palace.

Episodes.Title: Return
Episodes.Description: Lira escapes from Hagorn’s palace after a powerful blast frees her from the crystal, reuniting briefly with Kahlil before vanishing into the forest. As Alena finally returns to her true form, she is captured in Lireo, unaware that Pirena is no longer queen. With the Sang'gres scattered and Hagorn growing more ruthless, Amihan and Lira unknowingly move closer to each other in a desperate search to reunite.

Episodes.Title: Protection
Episodes.Description: Amihan and Lira are finally reunited, their long-awaited meeting filled with emotion and wonder. While Hitano secretly aids Pirena in locating Alena, Hagorn keeps both women imprisoned as he grows more suspicious. The rest of the rebels in Sapiro welcome Lira with warmth and joy—until Asval and his forces arrive, threatening the peace they’ve briefly found.

Episodes.Title: I Love You
Episodes.Description: Asval claims to be an ally and spy for Aquil, but doubts and tensions remain as the rebels celebrate Lira's homecoming. While Amihan and Ybarro savor moments with their daughter, Hagorn strengthens Lireo's magical defenses, making rescue attempts near impossible. Meanwhile, Alira Naswen betrays the group to Ether and Hagorn, putting their hidden refuge at grave risk.

Episodes.Title: Impending
Episodes.Description: As Amihan prepares her people to stand their ground against Hagorn’s army, Alira Naswen's betrayal threatens the safety of their stronghold. Ether frees Alira’s deepest resentment, unleashing her wrath on the diwatas who stand in her way. On the shores of Sapiro, both sides brace for war, unaware of the masked warrior in Hagorn’s ranks—and the dangerous deception within.

Episodes.Title: Clash
Episodes.Description: The battle between the forces of good and evil reaches a fierce crescendo as allies clash and loyalties are tested. Lira faces a mysterious pursuer while Alena desperately searches for her son. In the midst of chaos, a dark power from the past begins to awaken, threatening to change the tide of war.

Episodes.Title: Peril
Episodes.Description: Lira is heartbroken when a shocking battle ends with Danaya fatally striking Kahlil to protect her. As the Sang’gres attempt to revive him, the truth behind the Gintong Binhi and Cassiopea’s role in its disappearance is revealed. Alena finally reunites with the others—only to mourn her son’s death and vow vengeance against Hagorn.

Episodes.Title: Hatred
Episodes.Description: As grief consumes Alena, Lira gently reveals her true identity, deepening their emotional connection. But tensions rise when Pirena fuels Alena’s anger, leading to a fierce confrontation with Danaya. While Amihan, Ybrahim, and Lira try to bring peace and understanding, Alena is torn between heartbreak and vengeance, leaving Danaya’s fate hanging in the balance.

Episodes.Title: Ferocity
Episodes.Description: Alena struggles with grief and anger, blaming Ybrahim for choosing Lira over Kahlil. As tensions rise among the sisters, Amihan, Danaya, and Ybrahim prepare for a new chapter in Sapiro, unaware that Pirena and Alena are plotting an attack. When Alena abducts Lira, the stakes escalate, and the balance among the Sang’gres begins to unravel.

Episodes.Title: Discord
Episodes.Description: Alena revokes her blessing, causing Lira to lose her voice and faint, leading to a dramatic clash between the sisters. Ether manipulates the situation, transforming Lira into an unrecognizable creature to keep her from reuniting with Amihan. As everyone searches desperately, Lira—now in monstrous form—encounters Banak and Nakba, who fail to recognize her.

Episodes.Title: Selection
Episodes.Description: Amihan and her allies return to Sapiro without Lira, prompting Ybrahim to confront Alena. Ether makes a cruel offer to Lira: abandon her destiny in exchange for her true form—and imposes a curse when Lira refuses. Disguised and unrecognized, Lira bravely approaches her family, pleading to be accepted despite the spell that erased her from their memories.

Episodes.Title: Presumption
Episodes.Description: Lira's presence continues to confuse and divide Amihan's camp, as she insists on her identity despite being unrecognized. Meanwhile, Pirena and Alena attempt to forge an alliance with LilaSari to overthrow Hagorn, but mistrust threatens their fragile plan. Cassiopea confronts LilaSari, challenging her right to power and reclaiming the mystical Kabilan in a fierce duel.

Episodes.Title: No Surrender
Episodes.Description: Lira faces Danaya one last time, trying to convince her of the truth, but is once again cast out. As Hagorn prepares to launch a major attack, Amihan leads her allies to a highland pass and unveils a bold strategy using the power of the Earth Gem. Meanwhile, in both Devas and the mortal world, forces beyond the visible realm stir to guide Lira and Mira toward their destinies.

Episodes.Title: Pretense
Episodes.Description: The forest of Sapiro transforms mysteriously, confusing both Lira and her enemies. As tensions mount, a battle erupts that tests loyalties and brings the sisters back together—though not all is as it seems. Meanwhile, Mira's fierce determination leads her back to Encantadia, where she finds an unsettling mystery: no one remembers who Lira is.

Episodes.Title: Traitor
Episodes.Description: Lira grows more heartbroken as her family continues to forget her, while Mira makes her way toward Sapiro with the help of the white Retre. Alena and Ybarro confront their past feelings, but Amihan quietly suffers after witnessing them together. Just as Lira gives in to despair, an unexpected encounter brings her face-to-face with someone she never thought she'd meet.

Episodes.Title: Stratagem
Episodes.Description: Lira is overjoyed when Mira finally remembers her and agrees to help her reclaim her true form. The two brave Sang’gres confront Ether, only to be transported to a mystical place where they must prove their worth. Meanwhile, the Sang’gres attempt to gain allies for a daring plan against Hagorn as hidden agendas and shifting loyalties begin to stir.

Episodes.Title: True Colors
Episodes.Description: Tensions rise in Ascano as Ybrahim clashes with Asval over the claim to Sapiro. Back in Lireo, Pirena takes matters into her own hands, infiltrating Hagorn’s stronghold under disguise. Meanwhile, Lira, now in her true form, struggles with being unrecognized by her parents—even as Amihan confronts the traitor in their midst.

Episodes.Title: Conspirator
Episodes.Description: Pirena infiltrates Lireo to find Asval, but her disguise leads Hagorn to uncover her deception. In Sapiro, Amihan grapples with betrayal as tensions rise, and her trust in Alena crumbles. As the attack on Lireo begins, a clever infiltration plan unfolds, while Lira takes a stand against her aunts in a bold effort to protect her parents.

Episodes.Title: Captive
Episodes.Description: Ybrahim leads a daring assault to reclaim Lireo, while Amihan, Danaya, and their allies strike from within. LilaSari reveals her true allegiance with a shocking betrayal, seizing one of the powerful gems for herself. As Hagorn flees, the Sang’gres finally reclaim the throne—but new threats loom in the shadows.

Episodes.Title: Liberty
Episodes.Description: Amihan works to restore Lireo to its former glory and prepares to recover Alena's lost gem. Meanwhile, Lira remains in Pirena’s custody and reveals cryptic truths about herself, prompting Pirena to seek answers from Ether. As secrets resurface and alliances shift, LilaSari discovers an unexpected consequence of her past with Hagorn.

Episodes.Title: Power
Episodes.Description: Pirena takes Lira to Etheria, where Lira confronts Ether in hopes of lifting her curse. Meanwhile, Amihan and Danaya welcome Lira to Lireo as the kingdom begins its long road to recovery. But just as hope returns, a sudden attack shakes Lireo — leaving the people in shock and the queen in danger.

Episodes.Title: Heir
Episodes.Description: Amihan survives an assassination attempt, prompting Lireo to tighten its defenses while Hagorn watches and waits. As the kingdom urges Amihan to consider an heir, Lira feels increasingly displaced and mocked, unaware that her true identity is known to no one. Meanwhile, Danaya seeks the truth behind their mother’s death, and in a dream guided by Emre, Amihan comes face to face with a familiar figure from her past.

Episodes.Title: Escort
Episodes.Description: Amihan makes a difficult choice to protect her sister’s heart, turning away from Ybrahim and naming Mira as her successor. Lira travels to the mortal world to find Mira, only to cross paths with Agane, who has her own plans for the young heiress. As Mira returns to Encantadia, she faces unexpected danger—and an emotional reunion—with Pirena.

Episodes.Title: Arrival
Episodes.Description: Amihan and Alena launch an assault on LilaSari’s camp to reclaim the Water Gem, but Amihan halts the fight when LilaSari goes into labor. Tensions rise between the sisters as Alena confronts Amihan and Ybrahim about their hidden feelings. Meanwhile, Pirena faces rejection from Ether, Danaya uncovers the truth about Pirena’s power, and a mysterious child is born—one marked by fate, but not as a Sang’gre.

Episodes.Title: Suspicion
Episodes.Description: As Amihan strengthens Lireo’s alliances, internal rifts continue to grow among the Sang’gres—especially between Amihan, Alena, and Pirena. While Mira adjusts to her role as heir, Lira urges her to show Pirena compassion, even as Pirena plots a new conquest with Asval. Tensions escalate across Encantadia, and as old loyalties are tested, new alliances and betrayals begin to take shape.

Episodes.Title: Hagorn's Plan
Episodes.Description: Hagorn confronts Amihan not with violence, but with a chilling warning—his interest in Mira as a future ruler with Hathorian blood. Meanwhile, Pirena rallies an army of fugitives with plans to invade Sapiro, and Amihan braces for a new battle. Amid shifting powers, Danaya, Amihan, and their allies uncover disturbing signs of Hathor movement—and prepare for what lies ahead.

Episodes.Title: Danaya-Sari
Episodes.Description: A fierce clash erupts between Amihan and Hagorn, with the mysterious Danaya-Sari emerging from an unexpected fusion of powers to turn the tide. As Pirena leads an attack on Sapiro, bonds are tested and sacred artifacts change hands. With old wounds reopening and the threat of war looming larger than ever, the Sang’gres must face the consequences of divided hearts.

Episodes.Title: Succor
Episodes.Description: As Sapiro faces a full-scale invasion, Ybrahim, Amihan, and Alena fight separate battles to protect the realm from Asval’s forces and Pirena’s betrayal. Tensions rise when Pirena confronts her sisters, revealing harsh truths and igniting fierce confrontations. Meanwhile, Hagorn seizes the chaos to launch his own assault, and LilaSari escapes to the mortal world with Hitano and Deshna in search of peace.

Episodes.Title: Raid
Episodes.Description: Amihan and Alena suffer injuries. Cassiopeia urges Lira and Mira to seek help from Emre and their ancestors, but Lira hesitates to accept. Meanwhile, Pirena regains the Brilyante ng Tubig.

Episodes.Title: Journey
Episodes.Description: Lira sets out on a secret mission to Devas, hoping to find answers and healing before Christmas. Meanwhile, Danaya confronts a dark figure from her past, uncovering a painful truth about their mother's death. As tensions rise and loyalties are tested, a long-overdue reckoning brings closure—and sorrow—to the sisters of Lireo.

Episodes.Title: Purpose
Episodes.Description: Lira, Wahid, and Wantuk's journey to Devas is thrown off course when they're attacked by sky pirates, forcing them to crash-land in the desert. Meanwhile, Mira reveals her encounter with Cassiopea, and Amihan begins to suspect the depth of her daughter's intentions.
