As Ybrahim builds a new alliance to reclaim Sapiro, Pirena and Hagorn begin plotting a counter-strategy of their own.

Episodes.Title: Trap
Episodes.Description: Lira continues her journey with Wantuk and Wahid, offering kindness to a stranger despite dwindling supplies—unaware that her good deed will be rewarded in a surprising way. Amihan moves forward with her battle plan, but betrayal looms as Pirena infiltrates the ranks through deception. As tensions escalate across Encantadia, Lira soars toward her destiny—watched by none other than Emre himself.

Episodes.Title: Obstacle
Episodes.Description: As the battle for Encantadia intensifies, Amihan frees her allies in Sapiro, while Hagorn marches toward Lireo with a sinister plan. Lira finally reaches the gates of Devas, but Ether awakens a terrifying force to stop her. Meanwhile, Paopao’s innocent quest for a Christmas tree leads to a perilous encounter with the enemy.

Episodes.Title: Attack
Episodes.Description: Lira and her companions face the fiery wrath of Arde, the fearsome dragon and god of Balaak, who refuses to let them pass. In Lireo, Mira stands firm against Hagorn’s assault, defending the palace in Amihan’s absence. As battles erupt in both Sapiro and Lireo, allies rally and fates hang in the balance—with Lira swallowed whole and Amihan nearly defeated.

Episodes.Title: Reception
Episodes.Description: Pirena launches a full assault on the Sapiryan-held eastern palace as Ybrahim braces for battle. Meanwhile, Lira reaches Devas, where she finally meets Emre and makes a heartfelt wish. As the conflict in Sapiro escalates, alliances are tested and the Sang’gres reunite to face Pirena’s forces.

Episodes.Title: Intimidation
Episodes.Description: Lira joyfully reunites with her friends and prepares to return to Lireo, unknowingly pursued by dark forces. In Sapiro, tensions between Pirena and Ybrahim escalate as they agree to a fragile truce. Meanwhile, Lireo embraces the spirit of Christmas, even as Amihan and Mira struggle with truths left unspoken.

Episodes.Title: Celebration
Episodes.Description: On the eve of Christmas, Lira is captured by Hagorn and imprisoned in a tree by Ether, triggering the end of her curse. Mira reveals the truth about Lira’s identity, leading Amihan and others to finally remember who Lira truly is. As the spell breaks, the race begins to rescue the rightful heiress before it’s too late.

Episodes.Title: Wish
Episodes.Description: With Amihan and Ybrahim’s memories restored, the family sets out to rescue Lira from her enchanted prison just in time for Christmas. As Lireo celebrates the holiday with heartfelt reunions, songs, and laughter, long-standing bonds are rekindled and new ones strengthened. Yet not everyone joins the joy, as Pirena walks a different path, and Alena faces her own quiet sorrow.

Episodes.Title: Love
Episodes.Description: As Christmas lingers in Encantadia, Lira tries to heal old wounds—encouraging Pirena and Alena to reconcile with their families. Meanwhile, Amihan brings Paopao home to the mortal world, fulfilling a promise and ending a chapter with tears of gratitude. But peace is short-lived, as Pirena’s loyalty is tested in a deadly encounter with Hagorn and Gurna, with betrayal striking from the one she trusted most.

Episodes.Title: Want
Episodes.Description: As Christmas brings moments of tenderness between hearts in Lireo, a darker threat looms with Hagorn capturing Ybrahim and Pirena. Hagorn demands the location of LilaSari and his daughter in exchange for peace—forcing Amihan and the Konseho to weigh betrayal against war. While LilaSari enjoys a quiet life in the mortal realm, danger grows closer, and Encantadia braces for a choice that could shatter everything.

Episodes.Title: Combat
Episodes.Description: Amihan makes a bold choice: to save the hostages without betraying LilaSari, launching a risky plan to infiltrate Hathoria using captured Hathor armor. But just as victory seems within reach, Aquil and Muros are captured—and Aquil is faced with a devastating offer from Hagorn that could end the war. Meanwhile, Lira and Mira take matters into their own hands, setting off toward Hathoria unaware of the dangers ahead.

Episodes.Title: Betrayal
Episodes.Description: Ybrahim devises a plan to escape and save Pirena, just as Lira and Mira arrive in Hathoria to help. Meanwhile, Aquil makes a devastating choice in the human world, revealing the hiding place of LilaSari and Deshna to Hagorn. As emotions run high in Lireo and the truth comes to light, Amihan is forced to confront betrayal from one of her closest allies.

Episodes.Title: Punishment
Episodes.Description: Pirena is imprisoned by Danaya’s command, while Aquil must answer for his actions in betraying the queen. Mira refuses to face her mother despite Lira’s urging, as pride continues to divide the sisters. Meanwhile, Deshna vanishes under mysterious circumstances—an act that could alter the balance of power in Encantadia once more.

Episodes.Title: Retribution
Episodes.Description: Tensions rise in Lireo as Lira tries to care for the defiant Pirena, while Amihan prepares to pass judgment on Aquil for his disobedience. In Hathoria, Agane's hidden betrayal begins to unravel, even as Ether encourages her deception for darker ends. Meanwhile, LilaSari’s desperation to find her daughter leads to a confrontation with Amihan—and a chilling vision from Cassiopea.

Episodes.Title: Defense
Episodes.Description: Amihan faces the burden of leadership as tensions rise in Lireo, following LilaSari's outburst. Mira visits Pirena at Amihan’s request, but their emotional encounter only deepens the rift between them. Meanwhile, Alena discovers Deshna's identity and struggles with Cassiopea’s mysterious warning not to return the child to her real mother.

Episodes.Title: Jealousy
Episodes.Description: The search for Deshna intensifies as both the Hathors and LilaSari seek her whereabouts. Alena and Cassiopea make a fateful decision that could shape the child’s future, away from the darkness pursuing her. Meanwhile, Pirena escapes and sets her eyes on reclaiming her weapon.

Episodes.Title: Pursuit
Episodes.Description: Alena narrowly escapes Hagorn’s wrath, but not without consequence. Cassiopea reveals a painful truth to LilaSari, forcing her to choose between love and destruction. As alliances shift and secrets are uncovered, the Sang’gres begin to unite—just as a greater threat arrives at Lireo’s doorstep.

Episodes.Title: Deceit
Episodes.Description: Lira’s efforts to reach Pirena continue despite warnings, while Amihan makes a risky decision to deceive Hagorn in hopes of avoiding war. As the Sang’gres launch a surprise attack on Hathoria, the balance of power begins to shift. But Hagorn, enraged and desperate, seeks the dark aid of Ether to rebuild his forces.

Episodes.Title: Assistance
Episodes.Description: With his army decimated, Hagorn embarks on a perilous journey to Balaak to strike a deadly bargain with Arde. Tensions rise in Lireo as Pirena returns with grim news, while Lira clings to hope that compassion can still change hearts. As battles loom on both the physical and spiritual planes, the fight for Encantadia grows ever more intense.

Episodes.Title: Revival
Episodes.Description: Hagorn triumphs in Balaak and returns to Encantadia with a terrifying army of undead warriors. As a blood-red moon rises in the sky, signs of a dark prophecy begin to unfold across the realms. While trust among the sisters remains fragile, a warning from Cassiopea suggests that something devastating has already begun.

Episodes.Title: Spark
Episodes.Description: Lira and the diwatas learn the horrifying truth—Hagorn now commands the Hadezar, an unstoppable undead force immune to conventional weapons and even the power of the gems. As Lireo braces for attack, Pirena rushes to help in her own way, while the sisters realize their divided strength may no longer be enough. In Devas, Kahlil learns that unity may be the only way to defeat the darkness born from Balaak.

Episodes.Title: Bravery
Episodes.Description: As Hagorn prepares to take control of Lireo, Amihan faces impossible choices that could determine the fate of the realm. Pirena’s true intentions begin to emerge as she takes drastic action. Meanwhile, Lira and Mira take matters into their own hands, setting off a chain of events that could change everything.

Episodes.Title: Solidarity
Episodes.Description: As battles erupt within Lireo, old allies and enemies cross paths in unexpected ways. A long-hidden truth is finally revealed to Pirena, forcing her to confront her past. With hope slipping away, the Sang’gres must consider a desperate move to turn the tide.

Episodes.Title: Four Sang'gres
Episodes.Description: Pirena returns to her sisters with an emotional plea for forgiveness, revealing a hidden letter from their mother that changes everything. Just as the sisters begin to reconcile, the Hadezars launch a devastating attack on Lireo. Amid the chaos, Amihan begins to reveal a dangerous plan—one that may come at a great personal cost.

Episodes.Title: Decision
Episodes.Description: As Hagorn's forces prepare for a final assault, Amihan shares heartfelt moments with her loved ones, hiding the true extent of her intentions. Cassiopea receives a chilling vision foretelling death among the Sang'gres, while Lira and Mira discover a temporary way to fight the seemingly immortal Hadezars. With time running out, a desperate decision looms—one sister may have to make the ultimate sacrifice.

Episodes.Title: Sacrifice
Episodes.Description: Danaya and Alena reunite with their father in the mortal world, while Amihan prepares to make the ultimate sacrifice for Encantadia. In Sapiro, emotional farewells are exchanged as the sisters brace for an imminent battle. Amihan alone stands against Hagorn’s forces, determined to defend their kingdom at all costs.

Episodes.Title: For Encantadia
Episodes.Description: As Amihan fights to hold off the enemy, Alena arrives to save her—but insists on taking her place. A brutal confrontation ensues, leading to a heartbreaking loss that stirs grief across the realm. While Hagorn claims victory, the sisters vow to carry on the fight, honoring the sacrifice that was made.

Episodes.Title: Mourning
Episodes.Description: The Sang’gres and their allies mourn the loss of Amihan, paying tribute in a solemn funeral where her body vanishes into light. In Devas, Amihan pleads with Emre to let her return to Encantadia to help defeat Hagorn and the Hadezars. Emre grants her wish, telling her she will now forge her own destiny beyond fate.

Episodes.Title: Objective
Episodes.Description: As Encantadia prepares for war, Amihan is allowed to return with Kahlil—but only for a short time before the doors of Devas close. Danaya accepts the Air Gem and the burden of queenship, while Aquil proposes to her. Just as Hagorn’s forces strike, Amihan reappears in a pillar of light, shielding Ybrahim from death and confronting her enemies once again.

Episodes.Title: Hope
Episodes.Description: Amihan and Kahlil return from Devas to help defeat the Hadezars, earning the joy and relief of their loved ones. As Hagorn’s forces begin to crumble, Cassiopea challenges Ether in Etheria, seeking to end her threat. Amid the chaos, Mira is taken hostage, forcing the Sang’gres to prepare for another battle.

Episodes.Title: Bait
Episodes.Description: Cassiopea wounds Ether and gains a mysterious reward, while Hagorn receives a powerful sword that summons a fearsome dragon. As the Sang’gres mourn their fallen allies, they regroup and march toward Hathoria to rescue Mira. Meanwhile, Deshna, now renamed Luna, begins a new life among the nymfas, unaware of the final battle drawing near.

Episodes.Title: For Mira
Episodes.Description: A fearsome three-headed dragon is unleashed as Hagorn wages his final assault, but the Sang’gres unite to stop him. Amihan takes on the dragon, while Pirena, Danaya, and Kahlil face their own deadly battles. As the tide turns, Pirena makes a fateful choice that could change everything — but Ether’s wrath may still come to claim its price.

Episodes.Title: Encourage
Episodes.Description: With Hagorn defeated, farewells are exchanged as Amihan and Kahlil return to Devas — but Ether strikes back, setting a darker plan in motion. The kingdom mourns Pirena’s sacrifice, though strange signs suggest her story may not be over. In the heavens, Emre confronts Ether in a divine clash that could determine Pirena’s fate… and the future of Encantadia.

Episodes.Title: Duty
Episodes.Description: As a strange phenomenon lights up the skies of Encantadia, Emre battles Ether in a climactic confrontation. Pirena miraculously returns to life, while Mira, Lira, and the others grapple with the aftermath of loss and renewal. When Amihan’s final will is revealed, Danaya must choose between love and duty as she steps into her destiny as the new Queen of Lireo.

Episodes.Title: Salutation
Episodes.Description: Danaya is crowned Queen of Lireo, embracing her new role while Lira quietly mourns Amihan’s absence. Determined to reunite with her mother, Lira sets off for Devas with Mira, Wahid, and Wantuk, unaware that Ether may be preparing a new threat. As Lira pleads with Emre for Amihan’s return, she is granted a final, heartfelt reunion—just not the one she had hoped for.

Episodes.Title: Resolution
Episodes.Description: Lira’s emotional farewell with Amihan in Devas strengthens her resolve as she returns to Lireo to begin intense training with Mira. While the Diwanis are forged into warriors, Lireo, Sapiro, and Hathoria rise from the ashes, with Pirena, Danaya, and Ybrahim leading their realms into a new era of peace. But even as the realms flourish, Ether secretly revives the long-lost kingdom of Etheria—signaling the return of a powerful and ancient threat.

Episodes.Title: Rise
Episodes.Description: Cassiopea prepares for her divine transformation as she tests Lira and Mira with increasingly difficult challenges. While peace reigns across the kingdoms, danger brews in secret as Ether's plot to revive Avria moves forward. Back in Lireo, the Diwanis are honored for their growth—unaware that the Mother Gem is already under threat.

Episodes.Title: Avisala Luna
Episodes.Description: A dark force seeks the Mother Gem but is repelled, prompting Ether to reveal her return — and a powerful possession takes place. In the realm of the nymfas, Deshna, now called Luna, begins to show her strength and spirit. Meanwhile, Lireo celebrates the rise of new Sang’gres, even as shadows gather beyond the palace walls.

Episodes.Title: Opportunity
Episodes.Description: Cassiopea's spirit struggles to reclaim her body as Avria, the ancient queen of Etheria, uses it to deceive the Sang'gres. Danaya, Alena, and Pirena grow suspicious of Cassiopea’s strange behavior, but the truth remains hidden. As Ether establishes a new Etheria for Avria to rule, the battle for Cassiopea’s soul reaches a critical turning point.

Episodes.Title: Question
Episodes.Description: Luna becomes increasingly curious about her true identity, challenging Helgad’s secrets as strange occurrences stir unrest among the nymfas. Meanwhile, the rise of the Etherian palace and the reawakening of Avria, along with her formidable allies, mark a new threat to Encantadia. As Aquil, Pirena, and Danaya uncover signs of this looming danger, Lira and Mira receive a dire warning from nature itself.

Episodes.Title: Meeting
Episodes.Description: The presence of Emre is questioned as forces begin to stir both in Devas and Etheria. Pirena, Danaya, and Aquil make a shocking discovery inside enemy territory. Meanwhile, new alliances and old feelings come to light, setting the stage for greater battles ahead.

Episodes.Title: Settlement
Episodes.Description: Tensions rise as Avria’s true intentions come into question. Lireo faces internal confusion and suspicion, even as allies from the past return to assist. As secrets unravel, the Sang’gres begin to suspect that not all is as it seems.

Episodes.Title: Arrest
Episodes.Description: As control over minds and loyalties shifts, Pirena hatches a risky plan to expose the truth. Meanwhile, Ether’s power continues to suppress the Sang’gres’ ability to see clearly. With chaos mounting, a sacred gem falls into the wrong hands.

Episodes.Title: Secret
Episodes.Description: The battle over the Brilyantes reaches a turning point as Cassiopea makes a bold stand. The Sang’gres are forced to decide whom to trust in the wake of deception and stolen power. In Etheria, preparations for a dark resurrection begin.

Episodes.Title: Trust
Episodes.Description: Cassiopea’s fate hangs in the balance as trust is tested in Lireo. A mission to Etheria reveals just how deeply the enemy’s forces have grown. As ancient secrets resurface, the Sang’gres must confront powerful enemies both old and new.

Episodes.Title: Search
Episodes.Description: Danaya makes a pivotal decision regarding Aquil, even as doubts about his loyalty surface. Cassiopea begins a sacred mission to find new gem keepers while the Sang'gres and their allies launch a bold attack on Etheria. As battle ignites, secrets are revealed and powers are tested, with Avria’s return drawing ever closer.

Episodes.Title: Avisala Queen Avria
Episodes.Description: As the battle intensifies, Ether unleashes her true power, forcing the Sang'gres to retreat and rethink their strategy. Meanwhile, Amihan makes a fateful choice in Devas, risking everything for a chance to reunite with her loved ones through reincarnation. As she takes her first step back toward the mortal world, Queen Avria rises—fully resurrected and ready for vengeance.

Episodes.Title: Change
Episodes.Description: The Fire Gem chooses its next master, Luna, while in Etheria, Queen Avria commands her forces to grow stronger, sensing that emotions are the Sang’gres’ greatest weakness. Back in Lireo, tensions rise as Lira and Mira feel replaced by Cassiopea's search for new protectors, unaware that destiny is already guiding the Soul Gem toward Paopao in the human world. As Paopao remembers the world of Encantadia and his connection to it, the path home opens—and his journey back begins.

Episodes.Title: Misfortune
Episodes.Description: Pirena’s infiltration of Etheria is nearly thwarted when Avria and Ether uncover her identity, while back in Lireo, Danaya and Ybrahim begin preparing for Etheria’s impending invasion. In the human world, a grieving and struggling Paopao is chosen by the Soul Gem, awakening his destiny and reigniting his bond with Encantadia. As he steps through the Lagusan ng Pagkaligaw, Lira and Mira secretly plot to prove their worth by launching an attack on Etheria themselves.

Episodes.Title: Return to Encantadia
Episodes.Description: Lira and Mira face Avria and are nearly overpowered, but Pirena rescues them just in time, furious over their reckless disobedience. Meanwhile, Paopao finally returns to Encantadia, marked by the Soul Gem and guided by fate toward Lireo. As Etheria targets new lands for conquest, Ariana of Punjabwe defies their aggression, showing that new heroes may rise from the most unexpected places.

Episodes.Title: Destined
Episodes.Description: As Ariana miraculously returns to life, revived by Amihan's spirit and marked by the Air Gem, the Etherians continue their aggressive campaign—capturing the men of Punjabwe and infiltrating Lireo through deception. Lira and Mira grow suspicious of a fake Danaya, while Ariana begins her journey to Lireo, determined to fight back. Meanwhile, Alena returns and helps thwart Andora and LilaSari, as the battle lines between Etheria and Encantadia draw closer.

Episodes.Title: Intent
Episodes.Description: Danaya proves her identity, revealing that the impostor was Avria in disguise, trying to steal the Air Gem—only to learn that it can only be claimed by its destined keeper. While Ariana embraces her new role, Lira tries and fails to connect with the gem, leading Avria to target her directly. After Lira is kidnapped and nearly defeated, Paopao intervenes, saving her and revealing his return to Encantadia—just as war becomes inevitable and Avria rallies her forces for a grand conquest.

Episodes.Title: Feeling
Episodes.Description: Questions arise about whether Paopao, a human, could truly be one of the new chosen keepers. Ariana and Azulan arrive in Lireo, bringing both tension and unexpected revelations. As threats loom near, Lireo’s leaders must confront shifting alliances and unfamiliar powers.

Episodes.Title: Outdare
Episodes.Description: Ariana begins to learn more about her mysterious connection to the Air Gem as suspicions deepen among the Sang’gres. Lira and Mira make an emotional visit to the human world, while Pirena faces off with a proud newcomer. In Etheria, a fierce battle unfolds as Avria reveals the true extent of her power.

Episodes.Title: Desire
Episodes.Description: The Sang’gres formally approve the search for new gem keepers, but Pirena remains troubled that neither Lira nor Mira has been chosen. Meanwhile, Lira and Mira apologize to Ariana, hoping to prove their worth, and later sneak into Etheria in search of answers—only to witness Avria’s sinister power over the barbaros. As the gem symbols sense danger and fly off, Danaya, Pirena, and Imaw rush to an unknown threat, while a captured Luna and Gilas face certain death unless help arrives in time.

Episodes.Title: Doubt
Episodes.Description: The Sang’gres face a powerful new threat when Andora ensnares Danaya and Pirena, forcing Luna to prove her worth in the battle. Meanwhile, Hitano seeks out LilaSari and learns a painful truth that could change everything. Luna’s identity is finally confirmed, sending shockwaves through the royal bloodlines as the Fire Gem finds its rightful heir.

Episodes.Title: Guardianship
Episodes.Description: Mira and Lira confront their doubts and disappointments, only to discover that humility may be the key to their destinies. As all five gem keepers are finally revealed, preparations begin for their training and the looming threat from Etheria. The palace of Lireo braces for war, even as deception creeps closer under the guise of an ally.

Episodes.Title: Order
Episodes.Description: Ariana and the other new keepers continue their training, but tensions rise when Azulan disapproves of women bearing arms, leading to confrontations. Manik is revealed to be loyal to Etheria and launches a surprise attack on the keepers, forcing the Sang’gres to step in. As Lireo reels from betrayal, Avria masks her true intentions behind a façade of peace.

Episodes.Title: Measure
Episodes.Description: The Sang’gres defend Lireo from a surprise attack by pashneas, forcing the kingdom into chaos and evacuation. Avria unexpectedly appears to help repel the beasts and returns the Soul Gem, claiming to seek peace. While a feast is planned to celebrate this new alliance, both Pirena and Muyak remain wary—especially as Avria secretly prepares a deadly scheme.

Episodes.Title: Complete
Episodes.Description: As preparations for the grand feast continue, tensions rise over LilaSari’s possible attendance and a secret plot begins to unfold. While Lireo buzzes with celebration and old friends reunite, danger seeps in as a hypnotized soldier poisons the wine. Meanwhile, Muyak discovers her destiny as a chosen keeper, just as Avria readies her final move.

Episodes.Title: Feast
Episodes.Description: Tensions and emotions run high during a grand royal feast filled with music, dancing, and unspoken desires. Just as peace seems possible, a shocking attempt to poison the guests threatens the fragile alliance. With suspicion cast and secrets hidden, the festive night ends with dangerous implications.

Episodes.Title: Dispute
Episodes.Description: Avria unexpectedly releases her captives, claiming goodwill—but Pirena suspects a deeper motive. As covert plans unfold and hidden truths come to light, Cassiopea warns of growing danger and begins training the new keepers. While bonds of family and loyalty are tested, Ariana faces resistance in her resolve to follow Amihan’s path.

Episodes.Title: Difficulty
Episodes.Description: The young keepers prepare for their training as Ariana makes a crucial decision about her future. Tensions rise between Pirena and Azulan, while Alena faces new trouble from the rogue Gunikar tribe. In Etheria, Avria devises a plan to use Aquil’s identity to get close to Danaya, while Cassiopea begins the trainees’ first deadly challenge.

Episodes.Title: Impostor
Episodes.Description: As the training intensifies, some trainees break the rules and learn a hard lesson about honesty and restraint. Avria deceives Danaya and assumes her form in a bold move to infiltrate Lireo, but Pirena’s magic reveals something is wrong. Meanwhile, Alena confronts the Gunikar leader, and Amarro uncovers the dangerous limits of Avria’s powers.

Episodes.Title: Tiff
Episodes.Description: Pirena and the others awaken from a strange event, unaware that Danaya has been replaced. In Etheria, Avria and her allies plot to infiltrate Lireo using deception and magic. Meanwhile, the trainees struggle with their magical punishment as dark forces begin to move once again.

Episodes.Title: Mistrust
Episodes.Description: Danaya escapes Etheria, desperate to reveal the truth as Avria solidifies her place in Lireo. While some remain suspicious, Avria gains access to the gems and begins her plan to seize power. As Danaya battles her impostor, a tragic death sends a warning to the Diwatas—evil has entered their kingdom.

Episodes.Title: Shock
Episodes.Description: Tensions rise as suspicions about Danaya deepen, prompting Pirena and Ybrahim to act against her commands. The real Danaya seeks out Alena for help, while Avria continues to deceive the others in her guise. Cassiopea’s return begins to unravel the truth, leading to a dramatic confrontation where Avria is finally exposed.

Episodes.Title: Tragedy
Episodes.Description: As night falls in Capade, the Etherians launch a brutal surprise attack on the new keepers, resulting in devastating losses. Meanwhile, Danaya is restored to her true form, but struggles with guilt and heartbreak. In the aftermath, the Diwatas must rally to recover the gems and face Avria’s terrifying new weapon.

Episodes.Title: Anguish
Episodes.Description: A fearsome giant called the Kubur, immune to gem powers, attacks Lireo under Avria’s command. Meanwhile, Lira mourns Mira’s death but is relentlessly pursued and ultimately shot by Asval with a human weapon. As the Diwatas struggle to defeat the giant, Alena returns with powerful relics that help destroy it—but their victory is shadowed by unimaginable loss.

Episodes.Title: Wailing
Episodes.Description: Cassiopea brings home the tragic news: Lira, Mira, Wahid, and Gilas have fallen. Grief and anger erupt in Lireo, especially from Pirena and Ybrahim, who blame Cassiopea for the devastating loss. While Etheria rejoices, tensions grow among the Diwatas as they mourn their dead and question their next move in the face of rising darkness.

Episodes.Title: Puzzle
Episodes.Description: The kingdoms mourn as the bodies of their fallen return from the Retres, sparking grief, anger, and a thirst for justice. Pirena and Ybrahim demand war against Etheria, but Danaya and Alena hesitate, seeking Emre's guidance. Meanwhile, Avria uses powerful magic to summon Etheria’s past army, changing the tides of the war.

Episodes.Title: Ruling
Episodes.Description: Cassiopea and Imaw attempt to reach Devas, only to discover it has fallen to Ether, Arde, and Keros. As Luna seeks revenge on LilaSari, Pirena infiltrates Etheria in disguise to kill Avria, but her plan is thwarted. In the midst of chaos, a mysterious ally named Memfes appears, and the Diwatas begin to realize just how deeply their enemies have conspired.

Episodes.Title: Aspiration
Episodes.Description: Pirena confronts Avria in a brutal clash of powers, but the battle takes a dark turn when Avria uses magic to force Pirena to attempt self-destruction. Alena and Hitano arrive just in time, saving Pirena and forcing Avria to retreat. As Avria regains her strength through the stolen gems, a deadly new agent is unleashed to free a dangerous figure from the past.

Episodes.Title: Deity
Episodes.Description: A dark revelation unfolds as Imaw unveils the ancient deities of Encantadia and the mysterious God of Destruction, Keros, whose betrayal led to Emre’s fall. Luna is gravely wounded by LilaSari, unaware that her attacker is her true mother. Meanwhile, Hagorn escapes prison and is recruited once again by Ether, setting the stage for greater conflict across the realms.

Episodes.Title: Intention
Episodes.Description: Luna confronts the Diwatas for hiding the truth about her real mother, leaving her feeling betrayed and determined to go her own way. As tensions rise in Lireo, Cassiopea urges unity among the kingdoms after revealing the fall of Devas and Emre's defeat. Meanwhile, Cassiopea boldly invades Etheria, punishes her enemies, and reclaims the elemental gems, shaking the power balance once more.

Episodes.Title: Light
Episodes.Description: Pirena confronts Hagorn about Ether’s dark secrets and pleads for him to stand with her against Etheria. Meanwhile, Cassiopea successfully retrieves the Earth Gem and entrusts it to Danaya, strengthening the forces of the Light. As war looms, Pirena’s grief over Mira fuels her rage, while Ether cunningly introduces Luna to Hagorn, claiming he is her true father.

Episodes.Title: Force
Episodes.Description: Cassiopea reveals that Emre is alive and warns that the war cannot be won until Devas is reclaimed from the enemy. As the united armies of the Diwatas, Hathors, and Sapyrians march toward Etheria, Avria strikes first using the Air Gem, nearly suffocating them — until the Earth and Water Gems turn the tide. Despite Cassiopea's plea to delay the war, Pirena, fueled by vengeance for Mira, forges ahead with Ybrahim, determined to bring down Asval and Etheria once and for all.

Episodes.Title: Collection
Episodes.Description: The battle between the Etherians and the allied forces of Pirena and Ybrahim reaches a critical point until Cassiopea and the others arrive to stop the bloodshed. Danaya proposes a parley with Avria, hoping to buy time to shift the tides, despite doubts and suspicions on both sides. As Ether and Emre clash and the gods seek allies, the Diwatas prepare for a dangerous negotiation that may change the fate of Encantadia.

Episodes.Title: Prayer
Episodes.Description: The Sang'gres attempt to broker peace with Avria by offering their gems, though not everything is as it seems. While Etheria accepts the apparent truce, Lireo prepares for the next move with a secret plan. Meanwhile, Pirena infiltrates Etheria, setting her sights on the powerful Golden Hourglass.

Episodes.Title: Hara
Episodes.Description: Cassiopea and Emre seek the elusive Goddess Haliya, but Ether thwarts their every step. Pirena risks exposure to steal the Golden Hourglass, driven by a desire to change the past and save her daughter. As tensions escalate, alliances are tested and sacrifices loom ever closer.

Episodes.Title: Solicitation
Episodes.Description: Alena confronts Memfes about his hostage-taking and rejects his marriage demand, leading to a heated battle. In Etheria, Pirena and Luna infiltrate the palace but find the Golden Hourglass missing—unbeknownst to them, Hagorn now possesses it. Meanwhile, Cassiopea seeks answers from a mysterious creature about the elusive Bathalumang Haliya.

Episodes.Title: Follow
Episodes.Description: Pirena receives the Golden Hourglass from Hagorn and uses it to look back in time, hoping to change Mira's fate. As Avria confronts the Diwatas over the theft, tensions escalate into a fierce gem-fueled clash that exposes deeper divisions. Pirena is confronted by Andora, who forces her to choose between her mission and her endangered sisters.

Episodes.Title: Blaze
Episodes.Description: Paopao and Ariana journey to Etheria with the help of Muyak, where danger awaits. Pirena struggles with a difficult decision that could change the fate of her sisters. A clash erupts as new enemies from the past appear in the present.

Episodes.Title: Conflict
Episodes.Description: Pirena faces off against Avria near the Portal of Time, but betrayal changes everything. As Hagorn gains power, the Sang’gres regroup and return to Etheria. Cassiopea and Emre confront Ether, but a new curse threatens their path.

Episodes.Title: Reciprocity
Episodes.Description: Deshna struggles to accept the return of Asval and Andora, but Hagorn insists they are now allies for the sake of power. Meanwhile, Emre and Cassiopea seek Haliya’s powerful lost weapon as Ether’s poison threatens their lives. As Deshna questions her father’s cause, Pirena receives a bittersweet gift: a dream where she reunites with her daughter.

Episodes.Title: Yearning
Episodes.Description: Pirena reunites with Mira in a dream, where emotional healing and forgiveness take place. As the Diwatas and Sapiro prepare for battle, Hagorn relocates his forces and unleashes brutal attacks on civilians, signaling a larger war to come. Meanwhile, Pirena confesses a past betrayal, just as the Etherians arrive at Lireo’s gates, setting the stage for an intense confrontation.

Episodes.Title: Kiss
Episodes.Description: The Sang'gres accept a challenge to fight the Herans without the use of their gems, unaware that Hagorn plans to exploit the encounter. Meanwhile, Ariana experiences vivid visions from Amihan's past, leaving her confused about their meaning. As Juvila infiltrates Lireo using her powers over time, danger looms inside the palace while secrets and emotions stir among its defenders.

Episodes.Title: Tactics
Episodes.Description: Juvila infiltrates Lireo and nearly kills Ybrahim, prompting Alena and Danaya to intervene. Meanwhile, Ariana struggles against Manik’s authority, desperate to visit the injured king. As Etherian and Hathor forces launch an attack on Sapiro, Ybrahim, though still recovering, insists on returning—unaware of the storm gathering around Emre and Cassiopea.

Episodes.Title: Brutality
Episodes.Description: Emre and Cassiopea flee from Ether with the help of a powerful griffin, narrowly escaping thanks to Cassiopea’s magic. In Sapiro, devastation awaits Ybrahim and Alena, as they discover the kingdom has fallen to Hagorn’s forces. As Danaya recovers from grave wounds, the Diwatas regroup and brace themselves for an even greater threat whispered into Hagorn’s ear by Ether herself.

Episodes.Title: Allies
Episodes.Description: Pirena boasts that the Etherians were not truly powerful, but Danaya and Ybrahim warn against underestimating them. As the Diwatas prepare for war, Cassiopea seeks Haliya’s weapon, but is attacked by Arde’s monstrous creations. Just as the battle looms, Ether unveils her secret weapon: the return of Minea, now cloaked in darkness.

Episodes.Title: Surprise
Episodes.Description: The battlefield before the gates of Sapiro erupts as the Sang’gres and their allies face Asval and the united Etherian-Hathor forces. Shock grips the Diwatas when Minea, their long-dead mother, appears alive—now leading the enemy and seemingly under a dark enchantment. As truths blur and hearts are tested, Emre races to retrieve the De-jar while Danaya vows to uncover the force manipulating their greatest warrior.

Episodes.Title: Barrier
Episodes.Description: The Sang’gres draw close to Hagorn’s camp, determined to reclaim their mother, but their attempt ends in heartbreak. As Minea’s inner conflict begins to surface, Deshna takes a brave step that puts her in danger. Meanwhile, revelations about Ariana stir questions about her true nature and past.

Episodes.Title: Kiss
Episodes.Description: Deshna escapes Hagorn only to be captured by Diwata soldiers, while LilaSari and Amarro rush to her aid. As Ariana struggles with jealousy and confusion, Manik’s growing discontent leads him into dangerous company. The Sang’gres return to Hagorn’s camp with a bold plan, unaware that treachery awaits them.

Episodes.Title: Charge
Episodes.Description: The Sang’gres fight to escape Hagorn’s stronghold as Andora turns them against one another using her powers. With the help of Memfes and the Gunikars, they are rescued and return to Lireo, though Minea remains lost to them. Meanwhile, Emre battles Ether in Devas, as the threat of war looms ever closer to the heart of Encantadia.

Episodes.Title: Violence
Episodes.Description: War erupts at Lireo’s gates as the Sang’gres face off against Hagorn and his powerful allies. Amidst the chaos, secrets about LilaSari’s curse are revealed, and Minea begins to waver as her memories resurface. In a moment of defiance, she chooses truth over allegiance, confronting Hagorn with the strength of a mother’s love.

Episodes.Title: Life
Episodes.Description: Minea bids farewell to her daughters, leaving behind a growing tree imbued with the Water Gem. Pirena discovers that Lira and Mira’s bodies have vanished and later learns through the Balintataw that Arde has taken them. As Lireo regroups after the battle, tensions rise over their next move against Hagorn.

Episodes.Title: Devas
Episodes.Description: Deshna returns to Lireo, turning her back on her father Hagorn, who plots anew after learning of her defection. Pirena boldly infiltrates the enemy camp to confront Hagorn, but the standoff reveals deeper stakes. Meanwhile, Emre and Cassiopea are restored, just as Keros’ shifting loyalties raise new uncertainties.

Episodes.Title: Redemption
Episodes.Description: Lira and Mira attempt escape as Pirena risks everything to trade the Fire Gem for their safety. A surprise twist in the gem exchange turns the tide against Hagorn. At the same time, Keros is defeated by Ether and Arde, unleashing a storm that signals a great loss in the skies of Encantadia.

Episodes.Title: Submission
Episodes.Description: Lira, Mira, and their allies return to Lireo, but a dark spell strikes the two princesses, rendering them unconscious. As the Diwatas struggle to heal them, Pirena confronts Hagorn, who demands a steep price for their recovery. While Emre and his allies prepare for a covert assault on Devas, Pirena wrestles with an impossible choice that could cost her everything.

Episodes.Title: Urge
Episodes.Description: With Mira and Lira’s condition worsening, Pirena nearly surrenders to Hagorn’s demands before turning to her sisters for help. Emre’s forces make a daring infiltration of Devas as Ether offers him a dangerous ultimatum. Cassiopea sets a bold plan in motion to shatter the alliance of darkness, while Alena leads an attack to confront Hagorn directly.

Episodes.Title: Estasectu Encantadia
Episodes.Description: Alena confronts Hagorn with an ultimatum, demanding the cure for the princesses' illness or face their united might. Meanwhile, Cassiopea sows discord between Arde and Ether, and Deshna makes a fateful decision that ends in tragedy. With emotions high and alliances shifting, the forces of Encantadia brace themselves for an inevitable war.

Episodes.Title: Farewell
Episodes.Description: The Diwatas reel from the loss of Deshna as Hagorn cruelly uses her death to manipulate them further. As alliances grow stronger and Cassiopea evades Ether's wrath, the fate of the princesses lies in a grim bargain. The line between vengeance and justice blurs, as both sides prepare for what may be their final clash.

Episodes.Title: Preparation
Episodes.Description: Cassiopea risks everything to prevent the imprisoned Ivtres from being transferred, even as Ether and Arde discover her role in Arde's attempted assassination. Ybrahim makes a desperate decision to save Lira, while Emre and his allies confront the growing power of the dark forces. In a tragic turn, the battle for Encantadia claims a beloved figure, pushing Emre to unleash the full might of Haliya’s weapon.

Episodes.Title: Ace
Episodes.Description: While Ybrahim's choices sow tension among the Sang'gres, Emre regains his strength and turns the tide against Arde. As Lireo’s armies prepare for war, Pirena makes a heartbreaking decision to save her daughter, causing further division within their ranks. Meanwhile, Hagorn gains even greater power from Ether, setting the stage for an apocalyptic confrontation.

Episodes.Title: War
Episodes.Description: As the Diwatas prepare for war, Danaya enforces Lirean law by punishing Pirena and Ybrahim for their dealings with the enemy. Mira confronts Hagorn in a bold attempt to obtain the cure, only to witness the full extent of his newfound powers. With battle lines drawn and old allies reunited, the forces of Encantadia brace for a final, decisive clash that will determine the fate of the realm.

Episodes.Title: Ivo Livé Encantadia
Episodes.Description: The great battle reaches its climax as the Sang'gre sisters and their allies face Ether and Hagorn in a final clash that will decide the fate of Encantadia. With sacrifice, unity, and the power of Emre, peace is restored at a great cost. As the land heals and new rulers and heirs rise, a new generation is born — and with them, the promise of hope… and the shadow of a coming storm.

Entries.Title: Encantadia Chronicles: Sang'gre
Entries.Description: Terra, the missing daughter of Danaya, grows up in the human world, unaware of her true heritage. She takes on the role of a superhero before returning to Encantadia to confront a new enemy.

Episodes.Title: The Queen of the Cursed
Episodes.Description: The Sang'gre sisters once faced a mighty beast in a forgotten chapter of their past. In the present, troubling visions and ancient warnings hint at dangers yet to come. As a dark force rises in a distant land, old legacies begin to stir once more.

Episodes.Title: The New Savior
Episodes.Description: The queens of old prepare the next generation for a future that feels increasingly uncertain. As Cassiopea's visions grow more alarming, decisions are made that will change the fate of the realm. Meanwhile, a new power gathers strength in Mine-a-ve, with conquest set in motion.

Episodes.Title: The Cursed One
Episodes.Description: A mysterious book unlocks long-buried secrets tied to the origins of Encantadia’s newest threat. As the truth about Mitena’s past slowly comes to light, her thirst for vengeance only grows deeper. While the forces of good falter under the weight of hidden knowledge, darkness prepares to breach the realm once more.

Episodes.Title: Mitena's Enslavement in Mine-a-ve
Episodes.Description: Cassiopea’s search for answers leads only to more questions, as the secrets of the past remain tightly locked away. In Mine-a-ve, tensions rise between a daughter seeking strength and a mother clinging to safety. As Mitena’s harrowing history unfolds, a spark of hope emerges in an unexpected place.

Episodes.Title: The Life that the Fairy Danaya Lived in the Human World
Episodes.Description: Life in the human world teaches Danaya harsh truths about greed, kindness, and the value of gold. When tragedy strikes without warning, her peaceful days shatter into grief and fury. As sorrow gives way to righteous rage, Danaya calls upon the earth itself to aid her in her quest for justice.

Episodes.Title: A Tale of Two Fairies
Episodes.Description: Consumed by loss, Danaya hunts down those responsible and sets a solemn vow that only the worthy shall wield her husband’s blade. Her journey leads her to an unexpected bond with a grieving human whose kindness begins to restore her faith. As two wounded souls find solace in each other, a new spark of hope quietly ignites.

Episodes.Title: Mitena's Power
Episodes.Description: A long-awaited birth brings new hope to Encantadia, even as shadows from the past rise with vengeance in their hearts. While Mitena’s dark ascent continues, old secrets finally come to light, shaking the foundations of the present. With danger on the horizon, the realms must unite or face a storm unlike any before.

Episodes.Title: Farewell and Return
Episodes.Description: As the kingdoms brace for war, old alliances are rekindled, and new heirs step into the burdens of legacy. While personal doubts and heartfelt losses linger, the forces of darkness strike their first blow through deception. With the fate of Lireo hanging in the balance, the true battle for Encantadia begins.

Episodes.Title: The Descent of Darkness in Encantadia
Episodes.Description: Chaos erupts across the kingdoms as Mitena launches her deadly assault. With stolen power and cunning deception, she claims both gems and lives in her quest for vengeance. As the Diwatas scramble to regroup, a desperate call is made for the only Sang’gre who may still turn the tide.

Episodes.Title: The New Queen of Encantadia
Episodes.Description: As Encantadia reels from heavy losses, its defenders rally for one final stand against the rising tide of darkness. In the human world, Danaya faces treachery and heartbreak that reignite her fighting spirit. With armies aligned on both sides, the battle for the realm stands on the edge of eruption.

Episodes.Title: Another War in Encantadia
Episodes.Description: The battle for Lireo erupts in full force, testing the courage and resolve of Encantadia’s warriors. As defeat looms and leaders fall, a desperate hope flickers in the face of overwhelming power. With gems lost and heroes imprisoned, darkness casts its longest shadow yet across the realm.

Episodes.Title: The Meeting of Twins
Episodes.Description: Mitena tightens her grip on Encantadia, seeking to erase the legacies of the past. As Pirena makes a final stand, she is forced into exile, wounded and alone in the human world. Meanwhile, the last hopes of resistance now rest on a hidden child and the quiet prayers of those beyond the mortal realm.

Episodes.Title: Memen and Mitena: Father and Daughter
Episodes.Description: As Encantadia falls deeper under Mitena’s control, hope quietly endures in the human world where Terra grows up unaware of her true identity. While her protectors struggle to shield her, strange signs begin to surface, revealing her unique bond with nature. But as danger draws closer, even a hidden life may not stay hidden for long.

Episodes.Title: The Courage of the Young Terra
Episodes.Description: Danger creeps closer to Terra’s quiet life, triggering a strange force that shields her from harm. As questions about her past grow louder, she faces struggles that go beyond the ordinary. Beneath the surface, hidden enemies begin their search for the truth she has yet to discover.

Episodes.Title: The Powerful Mentor of Terra
Episodes.Description: As strange truths begin to surface, Terra is drawn toward a destiny far greater than she imagined. Meanwhile, the remaining heirs of Encantadia attempt to challenge Mitena’s cruel reign, only to suffer painful losses. While the faithful await a long-promised awakening, one young soul begins her path toward something extraordinary.

Episodes.Title: Terra and the Pashneas
Episodes.Description: Terra's bond with animals deepens when a dangerous incident at the zoo reveals a powerful new ability. But when a ruthless gang threatens the people she cares about, Terra learns that her gift has limits. In a world that won't stop taking, Terra begins to question how much she can give.

Episodes.Title: The Secrecy of Imaw
Episodes.Description: Terra's powers lead to devastating consequences, forcing her to confront the cost of using them. Meanwhile, a bold sacrifice deceives Mitena and shields the last Sang'gres from discovery. As old heroes fall and new ones rise, hope flickers in secret corners of a kingdom under siege.

Episodes.Title: Terra's Coming of Age
Episodes.Description: As Terra’s training intensifies under a mysterious mentor, hints of her true heritage begin to surface. In Encantadia, a young man begins to question who he truly is amid acts of quiet heroism. With Flamarra struggling to balance survival and secrecy, and Mitena drunk on power, the pieces of the prophecy quietly fall into place.

Episodes.Title: Gifts of Gold
Episodes.Description: Terra’s bravery and combat skills inspire her community, but her rising power draws concern from both family and mentor. As her mentor prepares to leave, he hints at Terra’s greater destiny and the trials that await. Meanwhile, in Encantadia, signs begin to stir that the prophecy is nearing its fulfillment.

Episodes.Title: Theft of the Pashneas
Episodes.Description: As Terra’s birthday approaches, she secretly turns to her powers to help her hungry neighbors. Emil and his men begin cracking down on the community. Meanwhile, Mitena receives a chilling vision that hints her reign may soon face a reckoning.

Episodes.Title: On the Sang'gre's Birthday
Episodes.Description: As her eighteenth birthday arrives, Terra faces the consequences of her selfless act. In Encantadia, Mitena questions her invincibility after a dream and a troubling answer from the Stream of Truth. Across worlds, signs of a greater destiny begin to unfold.

Episodes.Title: New Friends
Episodes.Description: On her eighteenth birthday, Terra discovers a strange new ability. While her friends and neighbors rally to secure her freedom, Emil secretly manipulates the system to keep her locked away. But when Terra returns home, she’s welcomed by voices she never thought she’d hear and a gift that may change her fate forever.

Episodes.Title: The Concealment of Ability
Episodes.Description: Terra’s birthday celebration takes a strange turn when she accidentally unleashes incredible strength. As Emil plots revenge, Terra becomes the target of a brutal ambush. Meanwhile, Flamarra tracks down Adamus, only to be rejected and forced to fight her own cousin.

Episodes.Title: The Threat Against Terra
Episodes.Description: Terra’s powers grow as she teleports away from danger and heals from a gunshot wound. While Emil’s men escalate their attacks, Terra finds strength in her adoptive family’s love and in the mysterious abilities she has gained. Meanwhile, Pirena desperately seeks a way back to her daughter, unaware that fate is already stirring in both worlds.

Episodes.Title: Inherent Power
Episodes.Description: Terra defends her family against armed attackers, revealing strength and powers that baffle even her enemies. As Javier fights for his life, Terra finds herself at the center of an escalating war she doesn’t fully understand. Meanwhile, in Encantadia, Adamus regains his stolen memories.

Episodes.Title: Gov. Emil's Oppression
Episodes.Description: In the aftermath of the attack, Terra's family struggles with injustice as powerful enemies twist the truth to their advantage. While Javier recovers in the hospital, new accusations threaten to tear their family apart. As Terra's powers surge with her growing anger, she finds herself on the brink of a perilous decision.

Episodes.Title: Wrath of Terra
Episodes.Description: Terra wrestles with helplessness as Javier is unjustly arrested. Meanwhile, Mitena gives the Mine-a-ves a dangerous advantage by lifting the language barrier. As the prophecy stirs and allies move into place, Terra's rage begins to shake the earth itself.

Episodes.Title: Persuading the Face of the Stream
Episodes.Description: Terra takes justice into her own hands and uncovers the truth behind her grandfather’s arrest. As Terra’s powers draw more attention at school, Cami begins to suspect something supernatural. Meanwhile, a dangerous robbery unfolds at the bank just as Terra, Dina, and Akiro arrive.

Episodes.Title: Resentment of Flamarra
Episodes.Description: Terra steps out of the shadows to stop a violent bank robbery. In Encantadia, the Adamyans earn the Stream's silence with great sacrifice, while Mitena inches closer to discovering her destined adversary. As Flamarra denies her legacy, enemies close in, and Pirena finally returns to a realm now ruled by fear.

Episodes.Title: Upon Pirena's Homecoming
Episodes.Description: Pirena reunites with her daughter, Flamarra. As old allies regroup and tensions rise, the search for Terra becomes more urgent than ever. Meanwhile, Mitena captures key rebels and asserts her dominance with the terrifying use of the four elemental gems.

Episodes.Title: The Mother and Daughter Sang'gres
Episodes.Description: Mitena tightens her grip over her captives as the twin moons rise. In Adamya, desperate choices are made to protect Pirena from herself. Meanwhile, Flamarra faces an uncertain fate, as Mitena asserts her claim as the new power in Encantadia.

Episodes.Title: Seizure and Suffering
Episodes.Description: While Mitena vents her fury on Flamarra, Pirena struggles with doubt and the burden of finding Terra in the human world. As Terra embraces her powers and saves lives once more, dark forces close in with plans to capture her. The path of destiny begins to shine brighter just as danger starts to follow.

Episodes.Title: Hidden Powers
Episodes.Description: As Pirena continues her search for her hadiya, the people are beginning to know more and more about the new superhero.

Episodes.Title: New Heroine
Episodes.Description: As Pirena continues her search for Terra, she sees a young woman with extraordinary strength and courage defending the people in the marketplace.

Episodes.Title: Challenge to the Defenders
Episodes.Description: Adamus will fight for his life and honor as he is forced into the Avevar Ultador. Meanwhile, Terra faces a looming danger brought about by her kind heart.
